paper.title: Attesting Model Lineage by Consisted Knowledge Evolution with Fine-Tuning Trajectory
paper.author: Zhuoyi Shang, Jiasen Li, and Pengzhen Chen, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; and State Key Laboratory of Cyberspace Security Defense; Yanwei Liu, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; and State Key Laboratory of Cyberspace Security Defense; Xiaoyan Gu, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; and State Key Laboratory of Cyberspace Security Defense; Weiping Wang, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences
paper.summary_zh: 该论文旨在解决开放模型库中未经授权的模型再分发和虚假模型溯源声明等安全问题，这些模型通常基于微调产生。论文指出现有基于静态架构相似性的方法无法捕捉知识动态演化关系，因此受人类进化遗传机制启发，提出了一种通过验证知识演化与参数修改联合轨迹来证明模型血统的新框架。该方法首先利用模型编辑量化微调引入的参数级变化，然后引入一种新颖的知识向量化机制，借助探测样本将编辑后模型中的演化知识精炼为紧凑表示，最后通过验证知识关系的算术一致性来实现血统的稳健认证。大量实验表明，该方法在多种现实对抗场景下均有效且具有鲁棒性，能跨分类器、扩散模型和大型语言模型等多种模型类型实现可靠的血统验证。

paper.title: Adversarial Patch EXterminator: Zero-Shot and Patch-Agnostic Defense Framework Against Adversarial Patch Attacks
paper.author: Jiayimei Wang, City University of Hong Kong; Tao Ni, King Abdullah University of Science and Technology; Guowen Xu, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China; Qingchuan Zhao and Cong Wang, City University of Hong Kong
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对计算机视觉系统面临的严重威胁——对抗性补丁攻击，旨在解决现有防御方案依赖先验知识或大量训练数据、在复杂物理条件下鲁棒性不足，以及对微小、不规则或高背景一致性补丁等挑战性案例防御效果有限的问题。为此，论文提出了APEX，一个零样本、补丁无关的三阶段防御框架。该框架首先通过边界框提取聚焦补丁区域，接着结合基于互信息的模糊热图与边缘感知的边界热图定位对抗区域，最后利用结构引导的图像修复来恢复图像。实验在多个数据集和现有最先进防御方法上进行，证明APEX能有效防御各种类型的对抗性补丁（如非自然、自然及红外图像），展现出卓越的补丁定位能力、对不同环境（如光照条件）的高鲁棒性以及在物理世界场景中保护多种模型的高性能。

paper.title: Quantifying Large Language Model Attacks Through the Lens of Model Cognition
paper.author: Xiuming Liu, Chaoxiang He, Xuanran Yu, Jichen Chai, Feiyue Xu, Sheng Hang, and Hanqing Hu, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Bin Benjamin Zhu, Microsoft Corporation; Hongsheng Hu, Shi-Feng Sun, Dawu Gu, and Shuo Wang, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
paper.summary_zh: 该论文关注大型语言模型易受恶意输入诱导生成有害内容的问题，指出当前安全机制（如关键词过滤或输出审核）大多忽视了模型内部动态。研究发现，与有害提示相关的安全特征在中间隐藏状态中具有高度可分性（探针准确率可达99%），即使模型最终输出合规内容，这些特征在内部也持续存在。利用这一观察，论文引入了层级毒性探针和多层互补检测框架（Sentinel），融合不同深度的信号进行检测。该轻量级框架（<5M参数）将误报率减半，在对抗性攻击下仍保持超过94%的检测准确率（基线下降32%），并优于Llama-Guard-3-8B。此外，该方法首次提供了安全相关信号在LLM内部如何出现、传播和衰减的量化、层级解析地图，为可解释的、由内而外的对齐与诊断提供了支持。

paper.title: SONIC: Concurrent Oblivious RAM & Data Structures for Low-Latency and High-Throughput
paper.author: Nihal Talur and Ioannis Demertzis, UC Santa Cruz
paper.summary_zh: 该论文旨在解决隐私计算中依赖加密或可信执行环境（TEE）时易受访问模式攻击和侧信道攻击的风险。论文指出现有的基于树或分区的ORAM方案在低延迟和高吞吐量之间存在割裂。为此，本文提出了SONIC，首个用于硬件飞地的ORAM，它用RingORAM取代了传统的PathORAM。该设计克服了所有树ORAM构建的核心挑战（如顺序驱逐瓶颈），实现了并发访问、批量驱逐和无锁操作。SONIC在单服务器上实现了最低150K、最高2M请求/秒的吞吐量，比EnigMap高28-197倍，比GraphOS高158-1065倍。此外，SONIC可作为Snoopy的子ORAM替代品，将处理1TB数据所需的服务器数量从数千台大幅减少至32台，实现了更实用的可扩展性。

paper.title: E2E-AKMA: An End-to-End Secure and Privacy-Enhancing AKMA Protocol Against the Anchor Function Compromise
paper.author: Yueming Li, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences; and University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Long Chen, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences; and Key Laboratory of System Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Qianwen Gao, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences; and University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Zhenfeng Zhang, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences; and Key Laboratory of System Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences
paper.summary_zh: 该论文针对5G标准中应用认证与密钥管理（AKMA）协议存在的安全与隐私挑战。AKMA允许应用服务商将用户认证委托给移动网络运营商，但其中的锚点功能（AAnF）若被攻破，可能导致用户登录活动被监控或通信内容被未授权访问；同时，用户永久身份标识（SUPI）暴露给外部应用功能会带来严重的隐私关联风险。为解决这些问题，论文提出了E2E-AKMA协议。该协议即使在AAnF被攻破的情况下，也能确保用户设备与应用功能之间建立端到端安全的会话密钥，并保证除5G核心网外，任何实体均无法将账户活动与用户真实身份关联。该设计保留了原方案无需复杂动态密钥管理和特殊硬件的优势。实验评估显示，其额外开销仅比原5G AKMA方案高约9.4%，表明其具有高效性和实际部署潜力。

paper.title: Stayin' Alive: How Global Stolen Data Markets Thrive on Telegram
paper.author: Tina Marjanov, University of Cambridge; Taro Tsuchiya, Carnegie Mellon University; Konstantinos Ioannidis and Jack Hughes, University of Cambridge; Nicolas Christin, Carnegie Mellon University; Alice Hutchings, University of Cambridge
paper.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了被盗数据市场如何在Telegram平台上持续存在并繁荣。通过对超过1500个频道的超过一年数据的收集与分析，论文刻画了这些社区在Telegram生态系统中的位置、提供的数据类型、运营地域分布以及规避检测的技术。研究发现，这些社区主要使用非英语运营，并依赖“网关频道”来增强韧性和增长。研究为学术界、平台方及执法机构监控和打击此类活动提供了重要依据。

paper.title: Hydrangea: Optimized Two-Round Partial Synchrony with Improved Fault Resilience
paper.author: Nibesh Shrestha, Supra Research; Aniket Kate, Supra Research / Purdue University; Kartik Nayak, Duke University
paper.summary_zh: 在部分同步模型中，拜占庭容错共识协议常面临低延迟与高容错性之间的权衡。本文提出了Hydrangea协议，通过调整参数，在特定故障组合下实现了两轮的乐观提交延迟，同时保持了较高的容错能力。论文还证明了相应的匹配下界，并在地理分布式部署中实验验证了该协议相比现有方案在延迟和吞吐量上的优势。

paper.title: Tracegram: Framing Trace-Level Traffic Analysis with Temporally-Aware Multiple Instance Learning
paper.author: Jian Qu, Yuchen Zhang, Jialong Zhang, and Jianfeng Li, MOE Key Laboratory for Intelligent Networks and Network Security, Xi’an Jiaotong University; Xiaobo Ma, MOE Key Laboratory for Intelligent Networks and Network Security and Shaanxi Province Key Laboratory of Computer Network, Xi’an Jiaotong University
paper.summary_zh: 现有网络流量分析方法多基于包或单个流，难以捕捉跨流的时序与关联上下文，这在分析如APT攻击等复杂行为时存在局限。本文提出Tracegram，将轨迹级分析形式化为多实例学习问题，通过组合流编码器和时序感知聚合模块来推理跨流关系并保留长程依赖。该框架在四个公开数据集的多项任务中取得了优于或可比现有方法的性能，并能通过关键流归因支持安全分析。

paper.title: PICS: Private Intersection over Committed (and reusable) Sets
paper.author: Aarushi Goel, Rutgers University; Peihan Miao and Phuoc Van Long Pham, Brown University; Satvinder Singh, Purdue University
paper.summary_zh: 私有集合交集协议在多次会话中可能被敌手通过使用不一致输入来利用。本文提出了一个新框架PICS，通过承诺集来强制执行跨会话的输入一致性。基于先进的VOLE-PSI协议，PICS使用轻量级密码学工具实现了高效的实例化。它在提供强接收方输入一致性的同时，仅引入了相对较小的通信和运行时间开销。

paper.title: Bridging Usability and Performance: A Tensor Compiler for Autovectorizing Homomorphic Encryption
paper.author: Edward Chen, Fraser Brown, and Wenting Zheng, Carnegie Mellon University
paper.summary_zh: 同态加密程序的性能高度依赖于明文数据在密文中的打包布局，手动优化困难。本文提出了编译框架Rotom，能够自动将张量程序向量化为优化的同态加密程序。它系统性地探索布局分配，并应用了最新的优化技术。评估表明，Rotom能显著减少旋转操作，并实现高达80倍的性能提升。

paper.title: Shadowfax: Hybrid Security and Deniability for AKEMs
paper.author: Phillip Gajland, IBM Research Europe – Zurich; Vincent Hwang, MPI-SP, Radboud University; Jonas Janneck, Ruhr University Bochum
paper.summary_zh: 在向后量子密码迁移的过程中，许多方案牺牲了可否认性这一重要属性。本文研究了如何在后量子认证密钥封装机制中高效地保留可否认性，提出了两种混合方案。其中，Shadowfax方案结合了经典非交互密钥交换、后量子密钥封装机制和后量子环签名，在不诚实或诚实接收者场景下均满足可否认性，并提供了高效实现。

paper.title: CuSafe: Capturing Memory Corruption on NVIDIA GPUs
paper.author: Hongyi Lu, Southern University of Science and Technology and Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Fengwei Zhang, Southern University of Science and Technology; Zhenkai Zhang, Clemson University; Shuai Wang, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Yanan Guo, University of Rochester
paper.summary_zh: 现代GPU应用因依赖C/C++等不安全语言而易受内存损坏错误影响，但现有方案或依赖非商用硬件，或性能开销过高。本文提出了CuSafe，一种可在商用NVIDIA GPU上部署的新型GPU sanitizer。它采用混合元数据方案并引入栈时代跟踪等机制，能够同时高效检测空间和时间内存错误。在包含大语言模型在内的程序测试中，CuSafe仅带来约13%的平均性能下降。

paper.title: PANGOLIN: Fuzzing Multilingual IoT Firmware with LLM-Driven Code Analysis
paper.author: Zhipeng Jia and Xiaokang Yin, Information Engineering University; Shuitao Gan, Laboratory for Advanced Computing and Intelligence Engineering; Chao Zhang, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, Tsinghua University; JCSS, Tsinghua University (INSC) - Science City (Guangzhou) Digital Technology Group Co., Ltd.; Hangtian Liu, State Key Laboratory of Mathematical Engineering and Advanced Computing; Jiangan Ji, Enzhou Song, and Ruijie Cai, Information Engineering University; Jinglei Tan, State Key Laboratory of Mathematical Engineering and Advanced Computing; Shengli Liu, Information Engineering University
paper.summary_zh: 多语言物联网设备通常有大量隐藏接口，其参数结构复杂，对其进行有效的模糊测试以发现漏洞是一个挑战。本文提出PANGOLIN，一个利用大语言模型驱动的模糊测试方案。它通过LLM分析API调度机制、执行跨语言分析生成参数规范，并利用响应驱动反馈进行修正。该方法发现了68个未知漏洞，显著优于现有工具。

paper.title: Side-Channel Attacks on Open vSwitch
paper.author: Daewoo Kim and Sihang Liu, University of Waterloo
paper.summary_zh: 虚拟交换机Open vSwitch广泛用于云系统，其内部缓存系统可能成为攻击面。本文从安全角度刻画了OVS的缓存系统，并发现了三种攻击原语。基于这些原语，论文展示了三种通过OVS进行的远程攻击：隐蔽信道、泄露远程用户数据包头部的攻击，以及监控远程受害者数据包速率的攻击，从而破坏了虚拟化环境的隔离性。

paper.title: Behind Bars: A Side-Channel Attack on NVIDIA MIG Cache Partitioning Using Memory Barriers
paper.author: Cheng Gu, University of Rochester; Reese Levine, UC Santa Cruz; Zhenkai Zhang, Clemson University; Tyler Sorensen, Microsoft and UC Santa Cruz; Yanan Guo, University of Rochester
paper.summary_zh: NVIDIA多实例GPU旨在提供硬件隔离，但其实现安全性需深入考察。本文实证研究发现，尽管设计了缓存分区，MIG实例间仍会发生L2缓存干扰，特别是由内存屏障引起的跨分区影响。基于此，论文开发了一种新的时序侧信道攻击，使一个MIG实例中的攻击者能够推断另一个实例中受害者的内核启动模式，从而威胁如大语言模型推理等应用的机密性。

paper.title: TrojPix: Electromagnetic Covert Channels via Imperceptible Pixel Modulation
paper.author: Guoming Zhang, Shandong University and Quan Cheng Laboratory; Huiting Zhang, Zhenwei Lu, Heqiang Fu, Xin Gao, Riccardo Spolaor, and Yetong Cao, Shandong University; Yanni Yang and Pengfei Hu, Shandong University and Quan Cheng Laboratory
paper.summary_zh: 气隙网络依赖物理隔离防止连接。现有的电磁隐蔽信道难以同时实现高吞吐、长距离和视觉不可见性。本文展示了通过不可察觉的像素调制可在数字视频线上确定性地诱导可控电磁辐射。基于此，提出了TrojPix隐蔽信道，在保持屏幕内容不可察觉的同时，实现了高速、长距离通信。该攻击在多种商用设备上实现了最高8.1 Mbps的峰值吞吐量和208米的最大距离。

paper.title: TIMESLICE-SANDWICH: A GPU Side-Channel Attack Exploiting Time-Sliced Scheduling
paper.author: Hodong Kim and Gyeongsup Lim, Korea University; Seunghee Shin, State University of New York at Binghamton; Youngjoo Shin and Junbeom Hur, Korea University
paper.summary_zh: 现代GPU使用时间片调度进行资源共享，但其安全影响尚未被充分研究。本文分析了时间片调度机制下的时序变化，发现可以通过推断并发程序的时间片时长来了解其GPU利用模式。据此提出了TIMESLICE-SANDWICH攻击，利用时间片时长的变化来推断和区分受害者程序的执行模式。实验表明，该攻击在神经网络恢复和网站指纹识别任务上均达到高准确率。

paper.title: Nudge: A Private Recommendations Engine
paper.author: Alexandra Henzinger, MIT; Emma Dauterman, MIT and Stanford; Henry Corrigan-Gibbs, MIT; Dan Boneh, Stanford
paper.summary_zh: 本文提出了Nudge，一个具有密码学隐私的推荐系统。Nudge由三个服务器和用户组成，服务器以秘密共享形式收集用户评分，并通过三方计算训练轻量级推荐模型。在整个过程中，服务器无法得知任何用户的具体偏好。其技术核心是新的三方矩阵分解协议。在Netflix数据集上的实验表明，Nudge在保持良好推荐质量的同时，实现了对用户隐私的强保护。

paper.title: United We Defend: Collaborative Membership Inference Defenses in Federated Learning
paper.author: Li Bai, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Junxu Liu, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and PolyU Research Centre for Privacy and Security Technologies in Future Smart Systems; Sen Zhang, Xinwei Zhang, and Qingqing Ye, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Haibo Hu, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and PolyU Research Centre for Privacy and Security Technologies in Future Smart Systems
paper.summary_zh: 联邦学习中的成员推断攻击威胁严重。现有防御通常独立应用于每个客户端，对利用训练全程信息的强大攻击效果有限。本文提出了CoFedMID协同防御框架，允许客户端合作以减轻隐私泄露。该框架包含样本选择、效用感知补偿和聚合中性扰动三个模块，在显著降低多种成员推断攻击效果的同时，仅造成很小的模型效用损失。

paper.title: On Evaluating the Robustness of Large Vision-Language Models via Untargeted Modality Alignment Breaking Adversarial Attack
paper.author: Zhichao Li, Hongshan Yang, Zhibo Wang, Huiyu Xu, and Junhong Lai, Zhejiang University; Yaopeng Wang, Southeastern University and Zhejiang University; Kui Ren and Chun Chen, Zhejiang University
paper.summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型易受迁移性对抗攻击，但现有评估方法常局限于扰动视觉编码器且未充分关注非目标攻击。本文提出了模态对齐破坏攻击，一种新的迁移性非目标对抗攻击，用于评估LVLM的黑盒鲁棒性。MABA强调破坏整个多模态流程，针对视觉编码和模态对齐两个关键阶段进行优化。大量评估表明，MABA在图像描述等任务上实现了最先进的攻击效果。

paper.title: MASLeak: Investigating and Exposing Intellectual Property Leakage Vulnerabilities in Multi-Agent Systems
paper.author: Liwen Wang, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Wenxuan Wang, Renmin University of China; Shuai Wang, Zongjie Li, Zhenlan Ji, and Zongyi Lyu, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Daoyuan Wu, Lingnan University; Shing-Chi Cheung, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
paper.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在协作中完成复杂任务，但其复杂性引发了知识产权保护担忧。本文引入了MASLeak，首个在实用的黑盒设置下系统性地从MAS中提取知识产权的框架。受计算机蠕虫传播启发，MASLeak通过精心设计的查询，从每个智能体中引出、传播并保留能揭示完整专有组件的响应。该框架在合成和真实MAS应用上均表现出高攻击成功率。

paper.title: Attacks on Approximate Caches in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
paper.author: Desen Sun, Shuncheng Jie, and Sihang Liu, University of Waterloo
paper.summary_zh: 为降低计算成本，文本到图像扩散模型常采用近似缓存，但这一优化通过打破用户间隔离引入了新的安全风险。本文全面评估了近似缓存引入的安全漏洞，展示了三种远程攻击：利用缓存的隐蔽信道、窃取已缓存提示的攻击，以及将攻击者标志嵌入被投毒提示的攻击。这些攻击证明了近似缓存在实际服务系统中存在严重的安全隐患。

paper.title: A Distortion-minimization Watermarking Framework for Large Language Models: Larger Capacity, Stronger Robustness and Higher Quality
paper.author: Liming Zhai, Xuezhou Shang, Liyun Zhang, and Po Hu, Central China Normal University
paper.summary_zh: 大语言模型水印需要在容量、鲁棒性和文本质量之间取得平衡。本文提出了一个失真最小化水印框架，在统一的优化范式下建模鲁棒性和质量为失真成本，以最小化总失真。该框架设计了利用语义不变性的鲁棒成本和引导修改到低凝聚性区域的质量成本，并提出了周期优化的编码方案。实验证明，DMW在所有标准上均优于现有方法，尤其在强改写攻击下优势明显。

paper.title: TopFeaRe: Locating Critical State of Adversarial Resilience for Graphs Regarding Topology-Feature Entanglement
paper.author: Xinxin Fan, State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; and University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Wenxiong Chen, Dalian University of Technology; and State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Quanliang Jing, State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Chi Lin, Dalian University of Technology; Shaoye Luo, State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; and University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Wenbo Song, Dalian University of Technology; and State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Yunfeng Lu, Beihang University
paper.summary_zh: 图对抗攻击通常从拓扑和节点特征两个角度发起，但现有防御未能充分揭示这两个方面如何融合以共学图表示。本文提出了一种通过定位图对抗韧性关键状态来进行防御的方法，借鉴了复杂动态系统中的平衡点理论。该方法将图建模为动态系统，设计了二维拓扑-特征纠缠扰动函数，并利用平衡点理论定位关键状态。在多个真实数据集上的实验验证了其有效性。

paper.title: Love, Lies, and Language Models: Investigating AI's Role in Romance-Baiting Scams
paper.author: Gilad Gressel and Rahul Pankajakshan, Center for Cybersecurity Systems & Networks, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri; Shir Rozenfeld, Ben Gurion University of the Negev; Ling Li, Ca' Foscari University of Venice; Ivan Franceschini, University of Melbourne; Krishnashree Achuthan, Center for Cybersecurity Systems & Networks, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri; Yisroel Mirsky, Ben Gurion University of the Negev
paper.summary_zh: 杀猪盘诈骗已成为全球主要的金融和情感伤害来源。本研究通过访谈、长期对话研究和安全过滤器评估，调查了大语言模型在其中扮演的角色。研究发现，LLM已广泛部署于诈骗组织中，能比人类操作员诱导更高的信任度和配合率，而流行的安全过滤器对此类对话的检测率为零。结果表明，此类诈骗可能易于实现大规模LLM自动化，而现有防御仍不充分。

paper.title: "Abuse Risks are Often Inherent to Product Features": Exploring AI Vendors' Bug Bounty and Responsible Disclosure Policies
paper.author: Yangheran Piao, Jingjie Li, and Daniel W. Woods, University of Edinburgh
paper.summary_zh: 随着AI厂商采用AI技术，漏洞披露政策对于鼓励和规范安全研究至关重要。本文分析了264家AI厂商的漏洞披露政策。研究发现，36%的厂商没有明确政策，仅18%提及AI特定风险。数据访问、授权和模型提取漏洞常被列为范围内，而越狱和幻觉常被列为范围外。研究识别出三种厂商类型，并指出厂商在解决AI漏洞披露问题上可能滞后于学术研究和现实事件。

paper.title: Turn Your Face Into An Attack Surface: Screen Attack Using Facial Reflections in Video Conferencing
paper.author: Yong Huang, Yanzhao Lu, Mingyang Chen, En Zhang, and Jiazi Li, Zhengzhou University; Wanqing Tu, Durham University
paper.summary_zh: 在视频会议中，人脸不仅是视觉焦点，也可能成为泄露屏幕信息的侧信道。本文发现，人脸在环境光和屏幕光的照射下能反射屏幕内容的变化。基于此，提出了FaceTell攻击系统，通过窃取视频会议中微妙的面部反射来窃听细粒度的应用活动。在真实测试环境中，FaceTell对28种常用应用的窃听准确率超过99%，并具有较强的环境鲁棒性。

paper.title: Nudge: A Private Recommendations Engine
paper.author: Alexandra Henzinger, MIT; Emma Dauterman, MIT and Stanford; Henry Corrigan-Gibbs, MIT; Dan Boneh, Stanford
paper.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对推荐系统中的用户隐私泄露问题，提出了一种名为Nudge的隐私保护推荐引擎。动机是解决传统推荐系统可能泄露用户偏好的风险。核心方法基于密码学隐私，采用三方计算协议进行矩阵分解，在服务器之间以秘密共享形式收集用户评分并训练模型，确保服务器无法获知个体偏好。实验在Netflix数据集上进行，结果显示Nudge能够在50分钟内以40GB通信量学习推荐模型，其推荐质量指标nDCG@20为0.29，与非隐私矩阵分解方法相当，接近非隐私神经推荐器的性能。这证明了在高效保护隐私的同时，可以实现高质量的推荐效果。

paper.title: When Authorization Loses Its Meaning: Breaking and Fixing Third-Party Online Payments
paper.description: Third-party online payment systems, such as Alipay and PSPB, constitute critical infrastructure for modern e-commerce. However, their security rests on the unrealistic assumption of fully trusted communication channels. While prior studies have identified isolated vulnerabilities, a systematic formal analysis of payment protocol security remains absent. This paper presents formal security models for six third-party payment protocols, spanning three major payment scenarios and two dominant payment service providers. Our analysis reveals a fundamental design flaw: whenever channel integrity is compromised between the merchant client, merchant server, or payment system, order tampering attacks become feasible. We validate this threat on Android, where over 20% of tested merchant applications allow order tampering through implicit Intent hijacking. To mitigate this threat, we propose user-side order authentication, where per-user-merchant key pairs cryptographically bind consent to order semantics. Formal verification demonstrates its resilience against identified attacks under weak channel assumptions. By bridging formal methods and empirical analysis, this work offers actionable guidance for standardizing secure payment protocols.
paper.author: Yongkang Xiao, Jing Chen, Min Shi, Kun He, Qiyi Deng, and Ruiying Du, Wuhan University
paper.summary_zh: 第三方在线支付系统如支付宝和 PSPB 是现代电商关键基础设施，但其安全依赖通信信道完全可信这一不现实假设，此前研究仅发现孤立漏洞，缺乏系统的支付协议形式化安全分析。本文为六种第三方支付协议建立形式化安全模型，覆盖三大支付场景和两家主流支付服务商。分析揭示一个根本设计缺陷：当商户客户端、商户服务器或支付系统之间的信道完整性被破坏时，订单篡改攻击即可实施。作者在 Android 上验证该威胁，超过 20% 的受测商户应用可通过隐式 Intent 劫持篡改订单。为缓解威胁，他们提出用户侧订单认证，用每用户—商户密钥对将用户同意与订单语义密码学绑定，形式化验证表明其在弱信道假设下可抵御已识别攻击。

paper.title: Breaking the Boundaries: Analyzing QUIC Frame-Packet Interactions With QUIC-Attacker
paper.description: QUIC is a new network protocol based on UDP that replaces TCP and TLS with an integrated protocol. It provides multiplexing of streams over a single encrypted and authenticated connection. The QUIC standard allows many different combinations of UDP datagrams, and QUIC packets, frames, and streams to transport the same information. This implies that testing the receiving side of QUIC is difficult. We develop probes to explore how different QUIC server implementations handle the coalescence and fragmentation of payloads, covering both valid and invalid combinations of datagrams, packets, and frames. Already at this basic level, we observe significant differences between implementations, some of which pointing towards exploitable vulnerabilities. Previous QUIC research tools were not designed to implement such probes. To address this limitation, we present QUIC-Attacker, a testing framework that allows maximum freedom on the sending side of QUIC. We present our results on these probes when applied to 15 QUIC server libraries, uncovering eight DoS vulnerabilities caused by unhandled exceptions and exploitable injection vulnerabilities in Kwik and Alibaba's XQUIC.
paper.author: Nurullah Erinola, Marcel Maehren, Marcus Brinkmann, and Jörg Schwenk, Ruhr University Bochum
paper.summary_zh: QUIC 是基于 UDP 并集成 TCP 与 TLS 的新网络协议，支持在单一加密认证连接上多路复用流；标准允许 UDP 数据报、QUIC 包、帧和流之间大量组合来传输相同信息，使接收端测试非常困难。作者开发探针以探索不同 QUIC 服务器实现如何处理载荷合并与分片，涵盖数据报、包和帧的有效与无效组合。为支持此类测试，他们提出 QUIC-Attacker，一个在发送端提供最大自由度的测试框架。对 15 个 QUIC 服务器库的测试发现 8 个由未处理异常导致的拒绝服务漏洞，以及 Kwik 和阿里巴巴 XQUIC 中可利用的注入漏洞。

paper.title: TONTOU: On the Exploitability of Time-of-Neutralization to Time-of-Use Windows
paper.description: Recently deployed Spectre v2 mitigations neutralize branch predictor state when switching privilege contexts or immediately prior to indirect branch execution, either through domain isolation or sanitization. These defenses assume that subsequent branch predictor behavior remains free from attacker influence until the neutralized state is used. Unfortunately, this paper shows that this assumption does not hold on recent AMD and Intel CPUs. We find that postneutralization (Time-of-Neutralization to Time-of-Use, TONTOU) windows can be exploited by an attacker to re-poison the predictor. Specifically, within the post-neutralization window, the attacker can re-direct control-flow of the victim to a training gadget that updates the predictor. To re-direct control-flow, we introduce INTERRUPT INJECTION, a primitive that exploits post-neutralization windows by leveraging the fact that interrupts can occur at nearly any point in time. Using this primitive, we demonstrate that an attacker can trigger mispredictions during kernel execution on recent AMD and Intel CPUs. To prove its practicality, we build an end-to-end exploit using INTERRUPT INJECTION that leaks arbitrary kernel memory on AMD Zen 2 at a rate of 5.47 bytes/s, despite the latest neutralization techniques.
paper.author: Daniël Trujillo and Mengjia Yan, MIT CSAIL
paper.summary_zh: 近期部署的 Spectre v2 缓解措施在特权上下文切换或间接分支执行前中和分支预测器状态，假设中和后的预测器行为在使用前不受攻击者影响。本文证明该假设在最新 AMD 和 Intel CPU 上不成立，发现中和后至使用前（TONTOU）窗口可被攻击者利用重新污染预测器。攻击者可在该窗口内将受害者控制流重定向到训练 gadget 以更新预测器，作者提出 INTERRUPT INJECTION 原语，利用中断几乎可在任意时刻发生的特点实现控制流重定向。基于该原语，作者构建端到端利用，在 AMD Zen 2 上以 5.47 字节/秒速率泄露任意内核内存，尽管已部署最新中和技术。

paper.title: HasteBoots: Proving TFHE Programmable Bootstrapping in Seconds
paper.description: Fengrun Liu, Carnegie Mellon University; Haofei Liang, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Xiang Xie, East China Normal University and Primus Labs; Yu Yu, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Wenting Zheng, Carnegie Mellon University; Yuncong Hu, Shanghai Jiao Tong University Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables computations on encrypted data, ensuring privacy for outsourced computation. However, verifying the integrity of FHE computations remains a significant challenge, especially for bootstrapping, the most computationally intensive operation in FHE. Prior approaches, including zkVM-based solutions and general-purpose SNARKs, suffer from inefficiencies, with proof generation time ranging from several hours to days. In this work, we propose HasteBoots, a succinct argument tailored for TFHE with programmable bootstrapping. By designing efficient protocols for arithmetic operations over quotient rings, HasteBoots achieves proof generation in a few seconds for TFHE evaluation with programmable bootstrapping, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art, Zama (CCS'25). Moreover, HasteBoots supports batching multiple TFHE evaluations and bootstrappings, a feature that prior work cannot practically support due to prohibitive proving cost. HasteBoots can prove a batch of 16 operations within one minute, while maintaining succinct verification, requiring only 126 ms and a proof size of 0.28 MB. Our approach demonstrates the potential for scalable and efficient verifiable FHE, paving the way for practical, privacy-preserving computations.
paper.author: Fengrun Liu, Carnegie Mellon University; Haofei Liang, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Xiang Xie, East China Normal University and Primus Labs; Yu Yu, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Wenting Zheng, Carnegie Mellon University; Yuncong Hu, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
paper.summary_zh: 全同态加密支持在密文上计算以保护外包计算隐私，但验证其计算完整性尤其是自举操作仍非常昂贵，现有 zkVM 与通用 SNARK 方案证明时间从数小时到数天不等。作者提出 HasteBoots，一种面向 TFHE 可编程自举的简洁论证，通过为商环上的算术操作设计高效协议来降低证明开销。实验表明，HasteBoots 可在数秒内完成 TFHE 可编程自举求值的证明生成，显著优于 Zama（CCS'25），并支持批量处理多个求值与自举。它能在 1 分钟内证明 16 个操作的批次，验证仅需 126 ms，证明大小 0.28 MB，为可扩展、可验证的 FHE 提供了可行路径。

paper.title: Orbit: Optimizing Rescale and Bootstrap Placement with Integer Linear Programming Techniques for Secure Inference
paper.description: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) allows computation on encrypted data without decrypting it. In theory, FHE makes privacy-preserving machine learning possible. In practice, however, it remains impractically slow for real workloads. A major source of slowdown is bootstrap operations; in CKKS, a popular FHE scheme for tensor workloads, the slowdown is compounded by scale management and rescale operations. FHE compilers for machine learning inference aim to make bootstrap placement and scale management efficient and easy by compiling high-level tensor programs into optimized CKKS computations. Unfortunately, existing approaches miss crucial optimization opportunities because they overlook a key property of CKKS programs: bootstrap and rescale placement are fundamentally coupled through the level budget. In this paper, we present Orbit, an FHE compiler that jointly optimizes bootstrap and rescale placement through a novel Integer Linear Programming (ILP) formulation that reasons about both ciphertext level and scale constraints. To make this formulation tractable for structured tensor workloads, particularly convolutional neural networks, we introduce three techniques that reduce ILP complexity while preserving optimality. Across five workloads and multiple cryptographic parameter configurations, Orbit achieves a geometric mean speedup of 19% over DaCapo, 73% over Orion, and 52% over ReSBM, keeps compilation under 6 minutes, and retains model accuracy within 0.3% of plaintext execution.
paper.author: Zikai Zhou, Tsinghua University; William Seo and Edward Chen, Carnegie Mellon University; Alex Ozdemir, Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy; Fraser Brown and Wenting Zheng, Carnegie Mellon University
paper.summary_zh: 全同态加密理论上可实现隐私保护机器学习，但 CKKS 中自举、尺度管理和重缩放导致实际推理速度极慢。现有 FHE 编译器忽略了 CKKS 程序的一个关键性质：自举与重缩放的放置通过层级预算相互耦合，因而错过重要优化机会。本文提出 Orbit，一个通过整数线性规划联合优化自举与重缩放放置的 FHE 编译器，同时考虑密文层级和尺度约束。为处理 CNN 等结构化张量负载，作者引入三种降低 ILP 复杂度且保持最优性的技术。在五个负载和多种密码参数下，Orbit 相比 DaCapo、Orion 和 ReSBM 分别取得 19%、73% 和 52% 的几何平均加速，编译时间低于 6 分钟，模型精度与明文执行相差不超过 0.3%。

paper.title: VROOM: Accelerating (Almost All) Number-Theoretic Cryptography Using Vectorization and the Residue Number System
paper.description: Modular arithmetic with a large prime modulus is a dominant computational cost in number-theoretic cryptography. Modular operations are especially challenging to parallelize efficiently on CPUs using vector instructions. Standard CPU implementations rely on costly carry operations and permutation instructions to align with the multiplication datapath, negating the benefits of vectorization. We develop vectorized algorithms for modular addition and multiplication, and present a new, constant-time modular multiplication algorithm suitable for general moduli—prime or otherwise. Our method uses a Residue Number System (RNS) representation to align the arithmetic naturally with wide vector units, and strategically eliminate extraneous instructions. Existing works either require the use of customized hardware or fail to show latency improvements. Reducing the latency of modular arithmetic results in speedups for cryptographic applications. We accelerate RSA-4096 signatures by 4.0× (verify) and 1.3× (sign) over OpenSSL, and speed up BLS signature verifications by 4.05× over the assembly-optimized blst library. To facilitate broad practical adoption, we are upstreaming our implementation into BoringSSL, where it will directly benefit real-world TLS and cryptographic deployments. Results on mapping our algorithm to Nvidia GPUs demonstrate speedups on modular multiplication over Nvidia's CGBN library.
paper.author: Simon Langowski, Kaiwen He, and Srinivas Devadas, MIT
paper.summary_zh: 大素数模运算的模加与模乘是数论密码学的主要计算开销，但在 CPU 向量指令上高效并行化很困难，因为传统实现依赖昂贵的进位与置换操作。本文提出基于剩余数系统（RNS）的向量化模加与模乘算法，并给出适用于任意模数（素数或合数）的常时模乘算法，使算术运算天然对齐宽向量单元并减少冗余指令。作者将实现加速应用于 RSA-4096 签名验证与签名、BLS 签名验证，并上游到 BoringSSL 以惠及真实 TLS 与密码部署。实验显示，RSA-4096 验证加速 4.0 倍、签名加速 1.3 倍，BLS 验证相比汇编优化的 blst 加速 4.05 倍；映射到 Nvidia GPU 上也在模乘上超过 CGBN 库。

paper.title: Amortizing Randomness Cost: Efficient Masked Implementation of SDitH Signatures with Common Shares
paper.description: MPC-in-the-Head (MPCitH) signatures are attractive for postquantum deployment, but they are structurally vulnerable to side-channel leakage: verification opens almost all simulated views, so any leakage correlated with the remaining unopened view(s) can be amplified and exploited to recover the witness. Among the MPCitH-based signature candidates considered in NIST’s additional-signature round, Syndrome-Decodingin-the-Head (SDitH)-Hypercube is particularly susceptible to this concern, since its signing process combines: (i) offline last-party completion involving nonlinear arithmetic computations, (ii) online Baum–Nof (BN) arithmetic checking, and (iii) Keccak sponge calls that generate or absorb secretbearing values. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first protocol-compatible masked implementation-level protection architecture for SDitH-Hypercube on Cortex-M4. Our implementation combines three techniques, each protecting one attackcritical hotspot: (i) Common Shares to amortize the masking randomness required by masked multiplications in the offline phase, (ii) a Sec/Pub typing discipline that reconstructs transcript-public and verifier-reconstructible values early to avoid costly Sec×Sec gadgets in the online BN kernels, and (iii) selective masked Keccak backends applied only to secretbearing sponge call sites. On the L1 parameter set, Common Shares reduces arithmetic masking randomness from 8.37 KiB/signature of the Strong Non-Interference (SNI) profile to 16 B/signature, while the Sec/Pub-typed optimization removes 3,264 B/signature from the online BN kernels. When Keccak is masked, masking randomness is dominated by the sponge: 41,118.75 KiB/signature with DOM-Keccak and 82,237.50 KiB/signature with SNI-Keccak, motivating selective masked hashing and tunable backends. We implement a low-stack reference signer and all protected signers on Cortex-M4. Across protected profiles, signing takes 913.7–1,542.0 Mcycles (1.84×–3.10× over the *Corresponding Author. reference), and fits within 155.6 KiB flash, 136.7 KiB static RAM, and 7.96 KiB signing stack. A 1M-trace first-order fixed-vs-random Test Vector Leakage Assessment (TVLA) experiment on Cortex-M4 no longer detects the previously observed leakage peaks after protection.
paper.author: Guowei Liu, Weijia Wang, Lixuan Wu, Chaoran Wang, Yanhong Fan, Jinliang Wang, and Meiqin Wang, Shandong University
paper.summary_zh: 基于 MPC-in-the-Head 的签名适合后量子部署，但结构上易受侧信道泄漏影响：验证会打开几乎所有模拟视图，与未打开视图相关的泄漏可被放大以恢复见证；NIST 附加签名轮候选 SDitH-Hypercube 尤其脆弱，因为其签名包含离线最后一方非线性计算、在线 Baum–Nof 算术检查和生成/吸收秘密值的 Keccak 海绵调用。本文提出据称首个在 Cortex-M4 上协议兼容的 SDitH-Hypercube 掩码实现级保护架构。该实现结合三项技术：用公共份额摊销离线掩码乘法所需随机数，采用 Sec/Pub 类型纪律提前重构公开与验证者可重构值以避免在线 BN 内核中昂贵的 Sec×Sec gadget，并仅对携带秘密的海绵调用点使用选择性掩码 Keccak 后端。在 L1 参数集上，公共份额将算术掩码随机数从 8.37 KiB/签名降至 16 B/签名，Sec/Pub 优化在线 BN 内核减少 3,264 B/签名；受保护签名耗时 913.7–1,542.0 Mcycles，为参考实现的 1.84×–3.10×，并适配 155.6 KiB flash、136.7 KiB 静态 RAM 和 7.96 KiB 签名栈；Cortex-M4 上 100 万条迹的一阶 TVLA 实验未再检测到此前泄漏峰。

paper.title: Patcher: Post-Hoc Patching of Backdoored Large Language Models
paper.description: Large language models remain vulnerable to jailbreak backdoor attacks, where adversaries poison safety alignment data to embed hidden triggers that bypass safety mechanisms. Existing defenses often require comprehensive attack information or multiple triggered examples, making them impractical when defenders only observe a single reported failure case without knowing whether it stems from a backdoor attack or a natural alignment bug. This paper presents Patcher, a post-hoc defense framework that repairs backdoored language models using only a single reported failure case and the model parameters. Patcher operates in two stages. First, it localizes backdoor triggers by computing response-conditioned gradient-based saliency scores and applying adaptive clustering to separate triggers from benign context. Second, it patches the model through a constrained fine-tuning objective that breaks the trigger-response association while preserving benign-task utility and robustness to non-triggered jailbreak attacks through KL-divergence constraints. We conduct extensive evaluations across multiple backdoor attack strategies and demonstrate that Patcher successfully localizes triggers and neutralizes backdoors while maintaining model utility. We further show robustness against adaptive attacks designed to evade our defense. This work represents a significant step toward practical defenses against training-time attacks in deployed language models.
paper.author: Anjun Gao, University of Louisville; Yueyang Quan, University of North Texas; Yufei Xia, University of Louisville; Zhuqing Liu, University of North Texas; Minghong Fang, University of Louisville
paper.summary_zh: 大语言模型仍易受越狱后门攻击，攻击者通过污染安全对齐数据嵌入隐藏触发器以绕过安全机制；现有防御通常需要完整攻击信息或多个触发样本，难以应对只有单个失败案例且不知其是否为后门的场景。本文提出 Patcher，一种仅使用单个报告失败案例和模型参数即可修复后门模型的后验防御框架。它分为两阶段：先通过响应条件梯度显著性分数和自适应聚类定位后门触发器，再通过带 KL 散度约束的受限微调打破触发器—响应关联，同时保持良性任务效用和对非触发越狱攻击的鲁棒性。在多种后门攻击策略上的实验表明，Patcher 能成功定位触发器并消除后门，保持模型效用，且能抵御自适应规避攻击。

paper.title: When the Aggregator Cheats: Data-Free Backdoors in Federated LLM-based QA Systems
paper.description: Chenqing Zhu, Southeast University; Yanbo Dai, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Yulong Tian, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics; Qingming Li, Zhejiang University; Songze Li, Southeast University and Engineering Research Center of Blockchain Application, Supervision and Management (Southeast University), Ministry of Education Large Language Model (LLM)-based question-answering (QA) systems are increasingly deployed in sensitive domains such as healthcare, mental health counseling, and legal consultation. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training without sharing raw client data, for which locally trained models are aggregated at a central server (i.e., a cloud service provider) to obtain a global model. In this paper, we explore the potential vulnerability where a malicious aggregator, who may collude with a third-party vendor, stealthily implants advertisement-type backdoors into federated QA models, without ever accessing client data. The attacker's goals are twofold: (1) preserve clean QA fidelity (i.e., the poisoned model behaves like a clean model on non-triggered queries); and (2) generate highly natural, contextually relevant responses with target advertisements when a trigger appears. Achieving these two goals simultaneously is highly challenging, as naive backdoor injection without knowledge about private data may degrade model's clean performance or fail to inject the target. Motivated by this, we propose to leverage clients' uploaded gradients during training, and develop a two-stage framework for data-free and stealthy poisoning: (1) recover representative training samples from client gradients, and (2) construct poisoning datasets utilizing recovered samples and trigger phrases to inject backdoors into the global model. Experiments across representative QA datasets and LLM families under full fine-tuning and LoRA settings demonstrate that, our method achieves nearly 100% Attack Success Rate (ASR) while incurring negligible degradation on clean tasks. Crucially, reconstructing only 5–20% of gradients suffices to mount a reliable attack, exposing a practical blind spot in the pipeline of federated training of QA LLMs.
paper.author: Chenqing Zhu, Southeast University; Yanbo Dai, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Yulong Tian, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics; Qingming Li, Zhejiang University; Songze Li, Southeast University and Engineering Research Center of Blockchain Application, Supervision and Management (Southeast University), Ministry of Education
paper.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的问答系统越来越多用于医疗、心理咨询和法律等敏感领域，联邦学习可避免共享原始客户端数据，但恶意聚合者可能与第三方供应商勾结。本文研究一种实际威胁：恶意聚合者无需访问客户端数据，即可向联邦问答模型隐蔽植入广告型后门，同时保持干净问答保真度，并在触发时生成自然且上下文相关的广告回复。作者利用训练中客户端上传的梯度，先恢复代表性训练样本，再结合触发短语构造投毒数据集，形成两阶段无数据隐蔽投毒框架。在多个问答数据集和 LLM 系列上的全量微调与 LoRA 设置中，该方法达到接近 100% 的攻击成功率，对干净任务性能影响可忽略，且仅重建 5%–20% 的梯度就足以发动可靠攻击。

paper.title: Unveiling the Pitfalls of Data-Free Backdoor Detection Against Pre-Trained Models
paper.description: Backdoor attacks pose a significant threat to deep learning models, enabling adversaries to manipulate the output through hidden triggers. Recent detection methods aim to identify backdoors without relying on clean samples or assumptions about attacks. Although they report strong performance, these methods are rarely evaluated on pre-trained models. In this paper, we present the first large-scale study of data-free backdoor detection on pre-trained models. Our benchmark includes more than 30,000 models and covers common backdoor attacks. We find that existing data-free methods fail on most pre-trained models, leading to a false sense of security. Despite our effective improvements, serious vulnerabilities remain. To address this, we propose using convergence speed as a new side-channel signal for backdoor detection. Using this signal, we reveal the cause of the remaining vulnerabilities and build a novel data-free detector that achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing methods. We further analyze how backdoor attacks evade detection and outline unresolved issues. Our results indicate that detecting backdoor attacks requires further exploration. We hope that our work can draw attention to the vulnerabilities in backdoor detection mechanisms for machine learning systems.
paper.author: Quan Zhao, Linkang Du, Yuntao Wang, and Zhou Su, Xi'an Jiaotong University; Zheng Li, Shandong University; Xiangshan Gao, Zhejiang University; Yang Zhang, CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security
paper.summary_zh: 后门攻击威胁深度学习模型，近期无数据检测方法声称无需干净样本或攻击假设即可识别后门，但很少在预训练模型上评估。本文首次对预训练模型上的无数据后门检测进行大规模研究，构建了包含 3 万多个模型并覆盖常见后门攻击的基准。研究发现现有无数据方法在大多数预训练模型上失败，造成虚假安全感；即使进行有效改进，仍存在严重脆弱性。为此，作者提出将收敛速度作为新的侧信道信号用于后门检测，揭示剩余脆弱性的原因并构建新的无数据检测器，取得优于现有方法的最新性能，同时分析攻击如何规避检测并指出未解决问题。

paper.title: Robust Watermarks Meet Backdoored Models: Evading Diffusion Semantic Watermarks via Stealthy Backdoor
paper.description: Jinyuan Liu, Tsinghua University; Tianshuo Cong, Shandong Key Laboratory of Artificial Intelligence Security, Shandong University; Pei Li, Shandong University; Tianrui Wang, Tsinghua University; Xinlei He, Wuhan University; Anyu Wang, State Key Laboratory of Cryptography and Digital Economy Security, Tsinghua University; Zhongguancun Laboratory; Xiaoyun Wang, State Key Laboratory of Cryptography and Digital Economy Security, Tsinghua University; Zhongguancun Laboratory; Shandong Institute of Blockchain; National Financial Cryptography Research Center Although semantic watermarking is considered a promising safeguard for images generated by Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs), the reliance of the watermark detection pipeline on neural networks introduces a critical yet underexplored backdoor attack surface. To systematically study this vulnerability, we propose GhostVAE to plant a stealthy backdoor into the encoder of Variational Autoencoder (VAE), enabling reliable evasion of watermark detection. GhostVAE operates in two stages: it first constructs a universal trigger via power spectrum regularization to improve the trigger robustness, and then trains a backdoored VAE encoder with a parameter-aligned objective. Through extensive evaluations across three state-of-the-art semantic watermarking schemes and three widely adopted LDMs, we show that GhostVAE preserves watermark detection performance on benign images (achieving an average true positive rate of 94.4%), while simultaneously enabling highly effective evasion under trigger activation (achieving an average attack success rate of 94.6%). Moreover, we comprehensively analyze seventeen representative defenses and demonstrate that GhostVAE remains stealthy across the input space, parameter space, and latent space. Our work fundamentally undermines the trustworthiness of semantic watermarking systems and highlights that secure deployment of semantic watermarks requires end-to-end security considerations, particularly for neural network components.
paper.author: Jinyuan Liu, Tsinghua University; Tianshuo Cong, Shandong Key Laboratory of Artificial Intelligence Security, Shandong University; Pei Li, Shandong University; Tianrui Wang, Tsinghua University; Xinlei He, Wuhan University; Anyu Wang, State Key Laboratory of Cryptography and Digital Economy Security, Tsinghua University; Zhongguancun Laboratory; Xiaoyun Wang, State Key Laboratory of Cryptography and Digital Economy Security, Tsinghua University; Zhongguancun Laboratory; Shandong Institute of Blockchain; National Financial Cryptography Research Center
paper.summary_zh: 语义水印被视为潜扩散模型生成图像的重要保护手段，但其检测流程依赖神经网络，引入了尚未充分研究后门攻击面。本文提出 GhostVAE，在变分自编码器（VAE）编码器中植入隐蔽后门，从而可靠逃避水印检测。GhostVAE 分两阶段：先通过功率谱正则化构造通用触发器以提升鲁棒性，再以参数对齐目标训练后门 VAE 编码器。在三种先进语义水印方案和三种主流潜扩散模型上的评估表明，它在良性图像上保持平均 94.4% 的真阳性率，同时在触发器激活时达到平均 94.6% 的攻击成功率；对 17 种代表性防御的分析显示，其在输入空间、参数空间和潜空间中仍保持隐蔽。

paper.title: Confundo: Learning to Generate Robust Poison for Practical RAG Systems
paper.description: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in real-world applications, where its reference-grounded design makes outputs appear trustworthy. This trust has spurred research on poisoning attacks that craft malicious content, inject it into knowledge sources, and manipulate RAG responses. However, when evaluated in practical RAG systems, existing attacks suffer from severely degraded effectiveness. This gap stems from two overlooked realities: (i) content is often processed before use, which can fragment the poison and weaken its effect, and (ii) users often do not issue the exact queries anticipated during attack design. These factors can lead practitioners to underestimate risks and develop a false sense of security. To better characterize the threat to practical systems, we present Confundo, a learning-to-poison framework that fine-tunes a large language model as a poison generator to achieve high effectiveness, robustness, and stealthiness. Confundo provides a unified framework supporting multiple attack objectives, demonstrated by manipulating factual correctness, inducing biased opinions, and triggering hallucinations. By addressing these overlooked challenges, Confundo consistently outperforms a wide range of purpose-built attacks across datasets and RAG configurations by large margins, even in the presence of defenses. Beyond exposing vulnerabilities, we also present a defensive use case that protects web content from unauthorized incorporation into RAG systems via scraping, with no impact on user experience.
paper.author: Haoyang Hu and Zhejun Jiang, The University of Hong Kong; Yueming Lyu, Nanjing University; Junyuan Zhang, The University of Hong Kong; Yi Liu, City University of Hong Kong; Ka-Ho Chow, The University of Hong Kong
paper.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）日益部署于真实应用，其基于参考的设计使输出看似可信，也推动了投毒攻击研究；但现有攻击在实际 RAG 系统中效果严重下降，因为内容常被预处理导致毒化片段被拆分，且用户查询往往与攻击预设不一致。本文提出 Confundo，一个学习式投毒框架，通过微调大语言模型作为毒化生成器，实现高有效性、鲁棒性和隐蔽性。该统一框架支持多种攻击目标，包括操纵事实正确性、诱导偏见观点和触发幻觉。实验表明，Confundo 在多个数据集和 RAG 配置上大幅优于多种专用攻击，即使在防御存在时仍然有效；作者还给出防御用例，保护网页内容不被 RAG 系统未经授权抓取，且不影响用户体验。

paper.title: Kintsugi: Empowering LLMs to Mitigate Web Vulnerabilities via Runtime Policy Injection
paper.description: The "response gap" between vulnerability detection and patching leaves web applications exposed to high-impact exploits such as remote code execution, command injection, and server-side request forgery. Current mitigations are flawed: code fixes often break functionality, while global runtime policies produce excessive false positives. We propose Kintsugi, an automated runtime containment system that provides temporary protection for exploits that manifest as diverging syscall behaviors at the OS level. Kintsugi uses a three-stage pipeline: First, by performing differential syscall analysis on normal and malicious requests, it locates a few vulnerability-related functions. Subsequently, leveraging LLMs, it precisely delineates the boundaries of the specific code snippets causing the malicious behavior within these functions and establishes policy trigger points. Finally, by analyzing the execution profiles from normal requests, it derives a deterministic, least-privilege syscall whitelist to serve as the runtime policy. This policy is enforced at the kernel level via eBPF and cgroups and is dynamically activated only when the request's execution flow enters the protected code snippet. Evaluation on 27 real-world CVEs across PHP, Python, and Java shows that Kintsugi effectively neutralizes diverse exploits and their variants while preserving original application functionality. Kintsugi achieves an average response time of 7.6 minutes. While the enforcement of surgical policies introduces a modest average latency overhead of 9.2% on targeted APIs, the impact on concurrent non-vulnerable traffic remains minimal, with an average throughput (RPS) drop of only 2.21%.
paper.author: Yihao Peng, Zizhen Zhu, Jiatian Hu, Jiaxu Wang, Hai Wan, and Xibin Zhao, Tsinghua University
paper.summary_zh: 论文针对漏洞检测与补丁之间的“响应空窗期”使Web应用暴露于RCE、命令注入和SSRF等高危利用的问题，指出现有代码修复常破坏功能，全局运行时策略又误报过多。作者提出Kintsugi，一个自动化运行时遏制系统，针对在OS层表现为系统调用行为偏离的Web利用提供临时保护。其流程为：通过正常与恶意请求的差分系统调用分析定位少量漏洞相关函数；利用LLM精确划定导致恶意行为的代码片段边界并设置策略触发点；再根据正常请求执行画像生成确定性的最小权限系统调用白名单，并通过eBPF和cgroups在内核层动态执行。在27个真实CVE（PHP、Python、Java）上，Kintsugi能中和多种利用及其变体且保留原功能，平均响应时间7.6分钟；对目标API平均延迟开销9.2%，对并发非漏洞流量影响很小，平均吞吐仅下降2.21%。

paper.title: Alias Equals Zone? Large-Scale and Stealthy Takeover of Domain Hosting Service via CNAME-Following Cross-Domain Verification
paper.description: Ruixuan Li, Tsinghua University; Xingyu Zhao, Zhejiang Gongshang University; Yunyi Zhang and Baojun Liu, Tsinghua University; Jun Shao, Zhejiang Gongshang University and Zhejiang Key Laboratory of Big Data and Future E-Commerce Technology CNAME records define alias relationships between domains and are widely used for service hosting and load balancing. We find that popular domain hosting providers misinterpret CNAME semantics during domain ownership verification. They accept DNS records after CNAME redirection as valid challenge tokens for alias domains, even though these domains do not configure any tokens. Based on this flaw, we propose ALIASLEAP, a novel domain takeover attack that enables hijacking hosting services of alias domains in CNAME chains. ALIASLEAP poses a serious threat in the real world: we identify four email and seven web hosting providers that are vulnerable, affecting over two million domains, including 200K in the Tranco Top 1M domain list. ALIASLEAP is highly stealthy because vulnerable CNAME chains are typically legitimate and long-lived: about half persist for more than 12 months, and up to 19,819 domains have been exposed for over 10 years. We propose mitigation strategies and responsibly disclose ALIASLEAP to 11 affected hosting providers, receiving confirmations from eight of them. We call on the Internet community to revisit the usage practices and capability boundaries of CNAME records.
paper.author: Ruixuan Li, Tsinghua University; Xingyu Zhao, Zhejiang Gongshang University; Yunyi Zhang and Baojun Liu, Tsinghua University; Jun Shao, Zhejiang Gongshang University and Zhejiang Key Laboratory of Big Data and Future E-Commerce Technology
paper.summary_zh: 论文发现流行域名托管服务商在域名所有权验证中错误理解CNAME语义：即使别名域未配置任何验证令牌，服务商仍接受CNAME重定向后的DNS记录作为有效挑战令牌。基于该缺陷，作者提出ALIASLEAP攻击，可劫持CNAME链中别名域的托管服务，导致大规模、隐蔽的域名接管。实测发现4个邮件和7个Web托管服务商受影响，波及超200万个域名，其中20万个位于Tranco Top 1M；且脆弱CNAME链通常合法且长期存在，约一半持续超过12个月，最多19,819个域名暴露超过10年。作者提出缓解策略并负责任披露给11家服务商，8家确认，呼吁社区重新审视CNAME记录的使用惯例与能力边界。

paper.title: An Integer Overflow Endgame: Compiler and Architecture Support for Default-On Integer Overflow Mitigation
paper.description: Integer overflow checks are off-by-default in most production settings due to their high overheads. Consequently, many serious vulnerabilities remain unmitigated. We analyze the source of these overheads---in compilers including LLVM (UBSan, Rust), and in processors including x86-64, ARM64, and RISC-V---and show how to eliminate them. Overheads in LLVM stem from how overflow semantics are expressed in LLVM IR. LLVM's current approach, based on intrinsics and branches, interferes with a variety of middle end optimizations. We develop an alternative approach that tracks overflow semantics with metadata, but otherwise leaves LLVM IR unchanged, eliminating this overhead. Overheads in hardware primarily result from current ISA designs, that require doubling the number of μops for checked vs. unchecked arithmetic, stressing the processor pipeline. We show how simple ISA extensions can alleviate this stress, enabling overflow-checked arithmetic to issue as a single μop. We evaluate these extensions through compiler-based emulation on real hardware and simulation in gem5. Our work offers a path to significantly reducing the cost of overflow checks in existing compilers, and demonstrates that integer overflow mitigation can be cheap enough for default-on use in future hardware.
paper.author: Zheng Zhang, Qi Ling, and Kian Kasad, Purdue University; Brendan Ryan Sweeney, UT Austin; Deepak Gupta, Meta Platforms Inc.; Tal Garfinkel, Google; Kazem Taram, Purdue University Distinguished Paper Award Winner
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注整数溢出检查因高开销而在生产中默认关闭、导致严重漏洞长期未修复的问题，系统分析了LLVM（UBSan、Rust）以及x86-64、ARM64、RISC-V等处理器中检查开销的来源。作者提出用元数据而非intrinsics和分支来表达LLVM IR中的溢出语义，从而避免干扰中端优化；同时设计简单ISA扩展，使带溢出检查的算术运算只需一条μop，而不是当前设计中所需的双倍μop。通过真实硬件的编译器模拟和gem5仿真评估，表明该方法能显著降低溢出检查成本，为未来硬件默认开启整数溢出缓解提供了可行路径。

paper.title: HyperAudit: Towards User Transparent and Highly Efficient System Auditing for Cloud Platforms
paper.description: Renpeng Zhang, Beihang University and Zhongguancun Lab; Kai Shen, Beihang University; Peng Jiang, Southeast University; Ding Li, Peking University and Zhongguancun Lab; Shujiang Wu, Beihang University; Lei Wang, Beihang University and Zhongguancun Lab System auditing is a critical security primitive for cloud platforms, but existing auditing frameworks place the log collection module inside the compromise-prone guest kernel. This design exposes a large attack surface and enables race condition attacks, where an attacker that compromises the kernel can tamper with uncommitted logs and erase pre-compromise traces. Prior secure collectors mitigate this by frequent synchronous or timed submissions, which incur non-trivial runtime overhead. We present HyperAudit, a hypervisor-assisted auditing architecture that isolates the log collection module from the guest kernel while keeping collection efficient and deployable. HyperAudit injects a kernel-independent collector into a hidden memory region, protects its code with execute-only permissions, and shields the log buffer with guard-page trapping, minimizing the exposed attack surface. Logs are asynchronously pulled by a consumer in a dedicated Secure VM, avoiding periodic synchronous commits. Under the common auditing assumption that logs generated after kernel compromise are untrustworthy, HyperAudit guarantees the integrity of all pre-compromise logs against race condition and flooding attacks. We implement HyperAudit on both x86 and Arm without extra hardware, and show that it reduces log-intensive application overhead by 49% and 66% compared to eAudit and HitchHiker, even outperforming host-only collectors.
paper.author: Renpeng Zhang, Beihang University and Zhongguancun Lab; Kai Shen, Beihang University; Peng Jiang, Southeast University; Ding Li, Peking University and Zhongguancun Lab; Shujiang Wu, Beihang University; Lei Wang, Beihang University and Zhongguancun Lab
paper.summary_zh: 论文针对云平台系统审计中日志收集模块位于易被攻陷的客户机内核、易受竞态攻击且难以保证日志完整性的问题，提出HyperAudit。它采用虚拟机监控器辅助的审计架构，将独立于内核的收集器注入隐藏内存区域，用仅执行权限保护代码，并用保护页陷阱保护日志缓冲区，从而最小化攻击面。日志由专用Secure VM中的消费者异步拉取，避免周期性同步提交的开销。在x86和Arm上无需额外硬件实现，实验表明HyperAudit相比eAudit和HitchHiker分别降低日志密集型应用开销49%和66%，甚至优于仅主机收集方案，并能在内核被攻陷后保证所有妥协前日志免受竞态和洪泛攻击。

paper.title: Anchors that Don't Lift: Understanding Supply Chain Driven Kernel Lock-In and Governance-Mediated Mitigation Strategies in SOHO Devices
paper.description: Small Office/Home Office (SOHO) devices are widely popular, yet often attacked due to security vulnerabilities in their firmware, affecting tens of thousands of devices at a time. These security vulnerabilities often stem from outdated Linux kernel versions included in SOHO device firmware. Naturally, prior work audited the extent and impact of this issue by simple Linux version extraction and version number based vulnerability mapping. However, it is unclear how many of these anticipated vulnerabilities actually exist in the heavily customized SOHO kernels and if there are any barriers towards updating Linux kernels in SOHO firmwares. To address this gap, we uncover actual kernel-related vulnerabilities found in 306 SOHO devices using a high-precision template-based CVE detection mechanism on GPL source releases of more than 900 firmwares from these devices (multiple versions per device). Next, as a first, we traced the supply chain of these vulnerable SOHO devices at scale and identify kernel lock-in as a significant security issue---SOHO vendors are effectively locked to specific (often older) kernel versions due to the system-on-chip (SoC) SDKs they use. This kernel lock-in produces a vulnerability debt that is inherited along the supply chain from SoC vendor to firmware creators (ODM/OEM) to router/IP-camera vendor and ultimately borne by end users. All five SoC vendors in our dataset have used SDKs with Linux kernels that had reached End of Life (EoL) more than a year before their usage in a SOHO device. Finally, we explore the mitigation-potential of individual, regulatory and community governance by analyzing social media posts, regulations and community efforts. Our results show that regulation compliance is insufficient and only SoC vendors who engage with communities for kernel upgradation offered a viable path towards mitigation. We conclude by discussing broader implications of our work for improving holistic security of the supply chain for SOHO devices.
paper.author: Ritwik Badola, IIT Madras; Rajdeep Ghosh, IIT Kharagpur; Ashita Gupta, IIIT Kottayam; Chester Rebeiro, IIT Madras; Mainack Mondal, IIT Kharagpur
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究SOHO（小型办公/家庭办公）设备因固件中过时Linux内核而长期遭受攻击的问题，指出以往仅靠版本号映射漏洞可能高估或误判实际风险，且不清楚定制内核中真实漏洞情况及更新障碍。作者对306款SOHO设备、900多个固件的GPL源码发布版进行高精度模板化CVE检测，并首次大规模追溯供应链，发现“内核锁定”是关键安全问题：厂商因依赖SoC SDK而被锁定在特定旧内核版本，形成沿供应链从SoC厂商、ODM/OEM、路由器/摄像头厂商到最终用户的“漏洞债务”。数据集内五家SoC厂商使用的SDK内核均在其设备使用前已EOL超过一年。作者还分析社交媒体、法规和社区治理的缓解潜力，发现合规监管不足，只有与社区合作推动内核升级的SoC厂商提供了可行缓解路径。

paper.title: Discovering, characterizing and exploiting controllable-copy objects for kernel data-only attacks with CopyKat
paper.description: Modern kernel hardening mechanisms considerably reduce the viability of control-flow hijacking attacks, prompting attackers to shift their focus to data-only attacks. These attacks depend on corrupting non-control data to amplify limited memory-corruption primitives into more powerful capabilities such as arbitrary writes. Prior work has identified small sets of such objects in specific circumstances. However, no existing approach discovers and characterizes them at scale. In this paper, we introduce CopyKat, a fully automated pipeline for identifying and characterizing Controllable-Copy Objects (CCOs): heap-allocated kernel structures whose fields can be corrupted to redirect a store or memory-transfer operation involving attacker-controlled data. We propose a multi-stage methodology with progressive filtering of objects. Through lightweight taint-analysis applied to a fuzzing campaign, we uncover candidate CCOs. Then, we confirm such taint by using a precise taint engine, thereby enhancing our precision. Finally, we perform the corruption of the CCO using a concolic execution engine to verify the controllability of the object. We also collect the necessary path and value constraints for exploitation. We find 122 verified CCOs and build 8 end-to-end exploits involving different exploitation patterns, showcasing the correctness of our characterization and the flexibility of the discovered objects.
paper.author: Jakob Koschel, Andrea Mambretti, Alessandro Sorniotti, Pietro Moretto, and Claudio Migliorelli, IBM Research Europe; Andrea Di Dio and Cristiano Giuffrida, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam; Anil Kurmus, IBM Research Europe
paper.summary_zh: 论文针对现代内核加固使控制流劫持攻击变难、攻击者转向数据-only攻击的趋势，研究如何将有限的内存破坏原语放大为任意写等强能力。作者指出现有工作只在特定条件下发现少量可被利用的非控制数据对象，缺乏大规模自动发现与刻画方法。为此提出CopyKat，一个全自动流水线，用于识别和刻画“可控复制对象”（CCO）：堆分配的内核结构，其字段被破坏后可重定向涉及攻击者控制数据的存储或内存传输操作。该方法采用渐进过滤：先通过模糊测试中的轻量级污点分析发现候选CCO，再用精确污点引擎确认，最后用concolic执行引擎实际破坏对象以验证可控性并收集利用所需路径和值约束。作者验证了122个CCO，并构建了8个不同利用模式的端到端exploit，证明了刻画正确性与对象利用灵活性。

paper.title: Principled Design of Indexing Functions for Memory Coloring
paper.description: On shared multi-core CPUs, memory coloring achieves microarchitectural isolation by partitioning resources between trust domains. Previous work has shown that memory coloring can, in principle, be used to isolate multiple components simultaneously, e.g., both the last-level (L3) cache and DRAM. The number of colors obtained by these methods depends on the algebraic properties of the indexing functions, though, and today's off-the-shelf CPU designs are often not suited for multi-component memory coloring. We develop algorithms to automatically synthesize indexing functions that guarantee a minimum number of colors. Given a set of typical workloads and some context on the CPU design, our algorithms compute a new linear indexing function that supports the requested number of colors while maximizing the performance on the workloads. Our approach is based on the observation that the number of colors depends on the overlap of the algebraic kernels of the involved indexing functions. Building on this observation, we translate the requirements that the CPU design imposes on the function into algebraic constraints that our algorithms enforce. In a case study on a 16-core server-class CPU, we show that our framework yields a coloring scheme that partitions the L3 cache and DRAM banks, increasing the number of colors from 1 to 16 while incurring less than 2.5% performance overhead, on average across SPEC and PARSEC benchmarks.
paper.author: Stephan Dübler and Jana Hofmann, Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (MPI-SP); Boris Köpf and Stavros Volos, Azure Research, Microsoft Distinguished Artifact Award Winner
paper.summary_zh: 论文针对共享多核CPU中内存着色难以同时隔离L3缓存和DRAM等多组件的问题，指出可用颜色数取决于索引函数的代数性质，而现有商用CPU设计往往不支持多组件内存着色。作者提出自动合成线性索引函数的算法：在给定典型工作负载和CPU设计上下文下，将CPU设计需求转化为代数约束，并通过分析相关索引函数代数核的重叠来保证最少颜色数，同时优化性能。在16核服务器级CPU案例中，该框架生成了可划分L3缓存和DRAM bank的着色方案，将颜色数从1提升到16，在SPEC和PARSEC基准上平均性能开销低于2.5%。

paper.title: When HTTP 402 Meets the Blockchain: Risks on Emerging x402 Payments
paper.description: x402 is an emerging payment protocol for Web APIs and autonomous AI agents. It is driven by the rise of LLM-based agents that can autonomously purchase access to online services. x402 extends HTTP 402 with a payment negotiation flow and delegates payment proof verification and on-chain settlement to third-party facilitators. As a result, facilitators serve as a shared payment infrastructure for many independent merchants. This centralizes trust and validation in one component, so a single flaw can affect many services. Despite rapid adoption by major vendors and economically meaningful mainnet activity, the security posture of real-world x402 deployments remains poorly characterized. We present the first systematic study of authorization correctness and execution safety in current facilitator-mediated x402 deployments in the wild, identifying eight security rules for facilitators as critical payment infrastructure. Based on our analysis of rule violations, we derive four new attack vectors, including Free Shopping , Asset Theft , Service Denial , and Gas Abuse . These attacks exploit weaknesses in the real-world facilitator and server implementations and cause severe harm, including direct financial loss to merchants, theft of facilitator-held assets, unbounded sponsor-paid gas/fees, and disruption of payment services. To assess the security of x402 deployments at scale, we propose a semi-automated black-box tool and apply it to 15 major x402 facilitators collectively used by over 60K sellers and 360K buyers. Alarmingly, we find violations in all evaluated facilitators. We responsibly disclosed our findings to the affected parties, who acknowledged the issues and adopted mitigations, including changes by Coinbase. Finally, we complement our controlled testing with an empirical measurement of over 119 million recent Base and Solana transactions, quantifying x402 adoption, facilitator centralization, and ecosystem-level risk indicators.
paper.author: Qinying Wang, EPFL; Yong Yang, Zhejiang University; Yuan Chen, Independent Researcher; Shouling Ji, Zhejiang University; Mathias Payer, EPFL
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究新兴的x402支付协议：它扩展HTTP 402，为Web API和自主AI代理提供支付协商，并将支付证明验证与链上结算委托给第三方facilitator。由于多个商家共享同一facilitator，信任与验证被集中化，单个缺陷可影响大量服务，但真实部署的安全性尚不清楚。作者首次系统分析facilitator中介的x402部署中的授权正确性与执行安全，提出facilitator应满足的八条安全规则，并据此发现四类新攻击：Free Shopping、Asset Theft、Service Denial和Gas Abuse，可导致商家资金损失、facilitator资产被盗、赞助gas被滥用及支付服务中断。作者实现半自动黑盒工具，测试15个主要x402 facilitator（覆盖超6万卖家和36万买家），发现所有被测者均存在规则违规；负责任披露后部分厂商（包括Coinbase）已修复。最后还测量了超1.19亿笔Base和Solana交易，量化x402采用、facilitator中心化及生态风险。

paper.title: Broken Promises: Who's Accountable When VPNs Fail?
paper.description: Roya Ensafi is a Morris Wellman Associate Professor of Computer Science and Engineering at the University of Michigan. She is the founder of Censored Planet lab which focuses on using data-driven approach to detecting and defending against powerful network intermediaries, government threat actors, and technologies that impact users' freedom of expression online. Prof. Ensafi has studied Russia's throttling of Twitter, HTTPS interception in Kazakhstan, and China's Great Cannon attack, among many other instances of network interference. She is a recipient of the Sloan Research Fellowship, NSF CAREER, Google Faculty Research Award, multiple IRTF Applied Networking Research Prizes, and the Consumer Reports Digital Lab Fellowship. Her work has been cited in popular publications such as The New York Times, Newsweek, Business Insider, Wired, and Ars Technica.
paper.author: Roya Ensafi, University of Michigan
paper.summary_zh: 该研究基于五年时间、上千名用户、九家VPN提供商和数百个桌面/移动应用的系统性测量，揭示VPN并不总能保护最依赖它们的用户。研究发现多重失败：kill switch在隧道故障时泄露真实IP地址，DNS查询逃逸隧道从而将浏览活动暴露给ISP或攻击者，部分VPN应用还会传输明文流量、以未加密方式下发配置文件，并外传广告ID用于跨应用追踪。报告由此追问VPN失效时的责任归属，强调需要重新审视VPN的安全承诺与问责机制。

paper.title: Securing Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation via Contextual Knowledge Injection: A Case for Embedded IoT Applications
paper.description: Repository-grounded retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) is increasingly used in embedded IoT development by retrieving code and documentation from a pinned RTOS/SDK repository (e.g., Zephyr OS). In this setting, security risks are often version-inherited: even without retrieval poisoning, generated applications may invoke benign-looking public APIs that transitively reach vulnerable internal routines in the pinned snapshot, thereby inheriting known CVEs. Existing secure RACG pipelines largely focus on task-level intent and generic vulnerability patterns, which can miss repository- and version-specific exposure. Meanwhile, conventional CVE scanners can flag vulnerable locations but cannot determine whether those vulnerabilities are reachable through the public APIs that the generator commits to during repository-grounded generation. In this paper, we present IoTRAGuarder, a contextual knowledge injection framework that aligns security hardening with generation-time API selection under repository grounding. IoTRAGuarder (i) recovers auditable reverse call chains from CVE-localized internals to exposing public APIs via static analysis plus an evidence-gated LLM to bridge indirections and macro-driven "call-graph islands", (ii) constructs a version-aware security knowledge base that binds affected version intervals to exposed public APIs with prompt-ready constraints, safer alternatives, or avoidance/upgrade guidance, and (iii) performs dual-layer, API-aligned online retrieval to inject concise, version-matched constraints into the final prompt. We evaluate IoTRAGuarder on 44 real-world Zephyr tasks across four LLMs. Compared to the prior state-of-the-art secure RACG baseline, IoTRAGuarder improves the overall security success rate from 5.11% to 78.41%.
paper.author: Tong Sun, Jingyi Su, Yi Gao, and Wei Dong, The State Key Laboratory of Blockchain and Data Security, College of Computer Science, Zhejiang University
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注嵌入式IoT开发中基于仓库的检索增强代码生成（RACG）的安全风险：即使没有检索投毒，生成的应用也可能调用看似正常的公共API，而这些API会间接到达固定RTOS/SDK快照中的脆弱内部例程，从而继承已知CVE。现有安全RACG流程多关注任务级意图和通用漏洞模式，难以处理仓库与版本特定的暴露；传统CVE扫描器也无法判断漏洞是否可通过生成器所选公共API可达。作者提出IoTRAGuarder，一种上下文知识注入框架：通过静态分析与证据门控LLM恢复从CVE定位内部点到暴露公共API的可审计反向调用链，构建版本感知安全知识库，将受影响版本区间与公共API及提示约束、安全替代或升级建议绑定，并进行API对齐的双层在线检索以注入版本匹配约束。在44个真实Zephyr任务、四种LLM上评估，相比先前最优安全RACG基线，整体安全成功率从5.11%提升到78.41%。

paper.title: The Six Developers You'll Meet in Security: Why Secure by Design Needs a Behavioral Playbook
paper.description: Dr. Enrique Larios Vargas is a Security and Learning Specialist at Adyen in the Netherlands, where he designs and leads large-scale security enablement programs for engineering teams in a global fintech environment. His work focuses on integrating behavioral science into secure software development, helping organizations move beyond compliance-driven approaches toward sustainable security culture. With over five years of experience across fintech, cybersecurity, and higher education, Enrique bridges research and practice. Prior to joining the industry, he served as a university lecturer and conducted research on behavioral factors in software engineering and cybersecurity. He holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Leiden University. Enrique is an active OWASP contributor, co-leads the OWASP Security Culture Project, and regularly speaks on human-centric cybersecurity, developer behavior, and security culture transformation. His mission is to make secure development not just a policy requirement, but the natural and easiest choice for developers and software teams.
paper.author: Enrique Larios Vargas, OWASP
paper.summary_zh: 该报告关注Secure by Design实践中开发者安全行为差异的问题，主张仅靠合规要求不足以推动安全开发，需要理解开发者行为并建立行为化操作手册。讲者结合在金融科技公司设计大规模安全赋能项目的经验，提出将行为科学融入安全软件开发，帮助组织从合规驱动转向可持续的安全文化。报告还介绍OWASP安全文化项目，强调以人为中心的安全、开发者行为和安全文化转型，目标是让安全开发成为开发者自然且最容易的选择。

paper.title: Youth Digital Immersion: Cyber Readiness Builds Mental Health Resilience
paper.description: Vivek Chaudhuri is a digital entrepreneur, Gen Z change-maker, and Director of Global Partnerships at SafeTeens Online (STO), a youth-led nonprofit advancing cyber-safety education and digital resilience. STO supports a global community of 5M+ teens across five countries and partners with organizations including the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the National Cybersecurity Alliance. In his role, Vivek leads the research, design, and delivery of youth-focused programming on cyber safety, digital literacy, and online resilience—translating complex online risks and human-factor challenges into practical, actionable learning. He is also expanding STO's impact into underserved communities in Africa, beginning with Ghana. Vivek has previously spoken at the National Cybersecurity Alliance's CONVENE Conference, sharing youth-centered insights with cybersecurity, law enforcement, and policy leaders. As a high school junior, he has also built award-winning digital solutions and enjoys programming, experimenting with generative AI, fencing, and practicing Taekwondo.
paper.author: Vivek Chaudhuri, SafeTeensOnline Global Head of Partnerships
paper.summary_zh: 该报告关注青少年网络安全与心理健康问题：每年约70%的青少年报告遭遇负面在线经历，但多数干预仍以限制为主，未能反映青少年真实的数字环境使用方式。讲者来自青年主导的非营利组织SafeTeens Online，介绍其面向青少年的网络安全教育、数字素养和在线韧性项目，并通过全球500万以上青少年社区及与政府、行业伙伴的合作来推广。报告主张以“网络准备度”建设心理韧性，将青年真实体验转化为可操作的学习内容，并扩展到非洲等欠服务社区。

paper.title: SoK: On the Fragility of Memory Error Exploit Mitigations
paper.description: The perennial war in memory has long been shaped by a continuous arms race: defenses are deployed, bypasses emerge, and stronger mitigations follow, only for the cycle to repeat. This pattern persists in part due to the fragility of many defenses, which often fail when assumptions change. Such fragility reflects how security guarantees are assessed, often through ad hoc reasoning tied to specific threat models. In a fast-evolving landscape of polyglot applications and heterogeneous systems, manually re-evaluating these guarantees for every new context is both labor-intensive and error-prone. This SoK advocates for a more systematic,adversary-aware approach. We introduce a graph-based framework for evaluating the fragility of memory safety defenses by modeling the progression of memory corruption exploits, and where, how, and under what assumptions defenses intervene and may fail. We demonstrate the utility of this model by revisiting flaws in prominent defenses and showing how their shortcomings could have been anticipated. Finally, we release open-source tooling that implements our model and supports systematized and semi-automated fragility testing.
paper.author: Adriaan Jacobs, DistriNet, KU Leuven; Mahmoud Ammar, Huawei Research, Germany; Stijn Volckaert, DistriNet, KU Leuven
paper.summary_zh: 该论文关注内存错误利用缓解措施的脆弱性，指出防御常在假设变化时失效，而现有安全保证评估多依赖针对特定威胁模型的临时推理。作者提出一种基于图的框架，建模内存破坏利用的进展过程以及防御介入和可能失败的位置、方式与假设。通过重新审视知名防御的缺陷，证明该模型能预测其不足。最后发布开源工具，支持系统化、半自动化的脆弱性测试。

paper.title: Fence2Pwn: KFENCE-Enabled Kernel Exploitation Bypassing Slab Hardening and Memory Tagging
paper.description: While the Linux kernel remains a prime target due to its privileged execution model, exploitation has become substantially more difficult in recent years. Kernel hardening efforts have increasingly focused on the slab allocator, aiming to mitigate entire vulnerability classes (e.g., via memory tagging) or disrupt exploit techniques (e.g., via heap object segregation). However, it remains unclear whether these protections are consistently enforced across all allocation paths. In this paper, we find that one allocation path is excluded from all state-of-the-art slab defenses: the path used for KFENCE allocations. KFENCE is designed as a low-overhead sampling-based memory-safety error detector for production kernels. It is enabled by default and active in billions of systems including on Android, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, and most Linux distributions. We show that it unintentionally enables a new exploit technique, Fence2Pwn. Concretely, Fence2Pwn leverages several KFENCE-specific behaviors. Three are particularly notable: (i) using a timing side channel, we detect when the kernel falls back to KFENCE allocations; (ii) KFENCE allocations are served by KFENCE-managed caches rather than size- and type-segregated slab caches, enabling bypass of heap segregation; and (iii) KFENCE allocations are untagged, enabling bypass of memory tagging. We evaluate Fence2Pwn by profiling our timing side channel, KFENCE's object slot dynamics as well as different environments and noise floors. Finally, we demonstrate that Fence2Pwn exploits this slab-defense gap: Fence2Pwn uses KFENCE to exploit an existing UAF-based memory-reuse vulnerability, which allows it to overlay security-relevant objects of different types and sizes.
paper.author: Ernesto Martínez García, Lukas Maar, Martin Unterguggenberger, and Stefan Mangard, Graz University of Technology
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究 Linux 内核 slab 分配器加固措施是否在所有分配路径上一致生效，发现 KFENCE 分配路径被所有先进 slab 防御排除在外。作者提出 Fence2Pwn 利用技术，通过时序侧信道检测内核回退到 KFENCE 分配，并利用其绕过堆隔离和内存标记。实验评估了时序侧信道、KFENCE 对象槽动态及不同环境噪声，并利用一个现有 UAF 内存重用漏洞覆盖不同类型和大小的安全相关对象。该工作表明默认启用的 KFENCE 可能无意中引入新的内核利用面。

paper.title: CoKeMon: Configurable Kernel Monitoring by Decoupling Isolation
paper.description: Monolithic OSes such as Linux are susceptible to security vulnerabilities. This has led to a line of research to detect and prevent runtime kernel exploitation, e.g., with kernel integrity measurement, page table monitoring, event logging. Prior works are either purpose-built for one type of monitoring or make invasive changes to the kernel. This motivates the need for a design that can accommodate various monitors on a need basis. As a first step, we identify five key requirements that such a solution must satisfy: selective permissions, non-privileged management, static isolation boundaries, architecturally-supported atomic switching, and device support. It is challenging to satisfy all of the requirements while preserving security. To address this, our insight is to decouple the isolation enforcement from the monitor management, which allows us to use native hardware techniques with ease. We demonstrate the feasibility of such a design on Arm platform by modifying ~300 LoC in the firmware and ~500 LoC in the Linux kernel. We implement three monitoring use-cases to demonstrate the versatility of COKEMON and report performance overhead ranging from 0% to 13%.
paper.author: Clément Thorens and Shweta Shinde, ETH Zurich
paper.summary_zh: 针对单体内核易受攻击且现有内核监控方案专用或侵入性强的问题，论文提出可配置内核监控设计 CoKeMon。作者识别出选择性权限、非特权管理、静态隔离边界、架构支持的原子切换和设备支持五项关键需求，核心思路是将隔离执行与监控管理解耦。在 Arm 平台仅修改约 300 行固件和 500 行 Linux 内核代码，实现了三种监控用例。性能开销为 0% 到 13%，展示了灵活部署多种监控器的可行性。

paper.title: Exploiting PoH Time Semantics in Solana via Re-Anchoring and Forking
paper.description: Proof of History (PoH) is a core component of Solana that realizes a publicly verifiable notion of logical time via a sequential hash chain. It allows Solana to run a slot-based leader schedule, where a designated leader is expected to propose a block in each slot. Yet, the security implications of PoH-driven logical time remain insufficiently understood. In this paper, we identify a new protocol-valid attack surface in Solana's PoH time semantics: by withholding and later releasing protocol-valid blocks that commit to an earlier PoH-derived logical time than a validator's current local view, a scheduled malicious leader can trigger PoH re-anchoring at honest validators. Building on this primitive, we develop two attacks. First, Time Inflation Attack (TI) extends the malicious leader's effective block-production time budget by multiple slot intervals, enabling it to include more transactions without necessarily invalidating honest blocks. Second, Fork-Assisted Time Inflation Attack (FTI) extends the former by leveraging fork choice to further increase the time budget while suppressing honest leaders' proposals. We present a formal analysis that characterizes the conditions under which PoH re-anchoring occurs and bounds the adversary's impact under realistic network and stake assumptions. We implemented the attacks in a testbed and reported our findings to the Solana development team. We also analyze on-chain data and report timing and inclusion patterns that are compatible with the incentive channel exploited by TI. Finally, we discuss defenses that harden PoH time semantics and reduce incentives to exploit PoH re-anchoring.
paper.author: Quanbi Feng, Southern University of Science and Technology; Pinshen Xu, Jianyu Niu, and Cong Wang, City University of Hong Kong; Yinqian Zhang, Southern University of Science and Technology
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究 Solana 中 Proof of History (PoH) 时间语义的安全影响，发现恶意领导者可通过扣留并延迟释放提交更早 PoH 逻辑时间的合法区块，触发诚实验证者的 PoH 重锚定。基于此原语提出时间膨胀攻击 (TI) 和分叉辅助时间膨胀攻击 (FTI)，前者延长恶意领导者出块时间预算，后者进一步利用分叉选择抑制诚实领导者提案。作者给出形式化分析，刻画重锚定发生条件并在现实网络和权益假设下界定攻击影响。在测试床实现攻击并报告给 Solana 团队，同时分析链上数据发现与 TI 激励通道相符的时序和包含模式，最后讨论防御措施。

paper.title: Just One Bit Vector: Complement-Free Ring Confidential Transactions with Transparent Setup
paper.description: Hao Gao and Qianhong Wu, School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang University; Hangzhou Innovation Institute of Beihang University; Bo Qin, Renmin University of China; Fudong Wu, School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang University; Hangzhou Innovation Institute of Beihang University; Zhenyang Ding, School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang University Ring Confidential Transactions (RingCTs) rely on their signature schemes to ensure transaction validity while preserving user privacy. In the discrete-logarithm setting, state-of-the art RingCT signatures leverage Bulletproof as their backbone. In this work, we conduct a thorough analysis of existing Bulletproof-based RingCT signatures and identify two pervasive sources of inefficiency: (i) redundant complement advice induced by binary constraints, and (ii) substantial overhead incurred by defenses against the Knowledge-of-Known-Discrete-Logarithm (KKDL) issue. We present new techniques that eliminate the first inefficiency and significantly reduce the second. We introduce the Weighted-Norm Inner Linear Argument (WNILA) as a new compression pivot and leverage it to design zero-knowledge proofs that capture constraints arising in RingCT without introducing complement advice. We then adopt the techniques of Omniring and Lin et al. to unify the K-Weight and K-Link techniques proposed by ZGSX23 and BulletCT. Building on this framework, we derive three RingCT signature schemes: UniBit, UniBit+, and UniBitRange. We implement all three schemes and benchmark them against BulletCT and Omniring⋆ under practical parameter regimes. Our experimental results demonstrate 2.540× improvements in signing and verification speed over Omniring⋆, and 1.6–2.3× signing speedups together with up to 1.65× verification speedup over BulletCT, while achieving comparable signature sizes.
paper.author: Hao Gao and Qianhong Wu, School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang University; Hangzhou Innovation Institute of Beihang University; Bo Qin, Renmin University of China; Fudong Wu, School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang University; Hangzhou Innovation Institute of Beihang University; Zhenyang Ding, School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang University
paper.summary_zh: 论文分析基于 Bulletproof 的 RingCT 签名，指出两类普遍低效来源：二进制约束导致的冗余补码建议，以及为防御 KKDL 问题带来的显著开销。作者提出 Weighted-Norm Inner Linear Argument (WNILA) 作为压缩支点，设计无需补码建议的零知识证明，并统一 K-Weight 与 K-Link 技术。由此导出 UniBit、UniBit+ 和 UniBitRange 三种 RingCT 签名方案，并在实际参数下进行实现与基准测试。结果显示签名和验证速度较 Omniring⋆ 提升 2.540 倍，较 BulletCT 签名加速 1.6–2.3 倍、验证最高加速 1.65 倍，签名大小相当。

paper.title: MHOT: Height-Optimized Authenticated Data Structure for Blockchain State Commitment
paper.description: State root computation dominates (~78%) blockchain block processing time. Ethereum's canonical authenticated data structure, i.e., Merkle Patricia Trie (MPT), suffers from severe tree-height growth and is vulnerable to Nurgle attacks (S&P'24), where adversaries inflate path depth via hash collisions and degrade system performance at negligible cost. Existing defenses increase node fanout (span) to bound tree height, but higher span inflates proof size exponentially. Prior work mitigates this trade-off using vector commitments, at the cost of trusted setup or expensive verification. We present MHOT, a height-optimal authenticated data structure for blockchain state commitment that preserves standard hash-based verification without trusted setup. Unlike MPT's fixed-prefix indexing, which couples span and fanout exponentially, MHOT indexes by discriminative bits that actually distinguish keys, achieving adaptive span with linear fanout coupling and provably minimal height. To prevent high fanout from inflating proofs, we introduce hierarchical proofs, a two-layer Merkle construction that reduces per-node proof overhead from O(k) to O(logk). On Ethereum mainnet workloads, MHOT achieves up to 9× higher write throughput, 4× lower write amplification, and 2× smaller proofs than MPT. Under Nurgle attacks, even when the adversary consumes an entire block's gas budget, MHOT maintains a 0% attack success rate (v.s., 99.97% for MPT). Our results, somewhat surprisingly, show that height optimality (not new crypto primitives!) is the key abstraction for scalable and attack-resilient blockchain state commitment.
paper.author: Sipeng Xie, Qianhong Wu, Minghang Li, and Qiyuan Gao, Beihang University; Bo Qin, Renmin University of China; Qin Wang, Independent
