Experiments across multiple adversarial benchmarks demonstrate that SafeAdapt significantly improves safety performance with a more ideal thinking budget under diverse and challenging attack settings.
paper.author: Jiazheng Song, Zhejiang University; Junxu Liu, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Jian Lou, Sun Yat-sen University; Jinfei Liu, Zhejiang University
paper.summary_zh: 推理模型因强 Chain-of-Thought 能力而日益重要，近期研究探索“安全思考”以评估输入提示安全性并阻止有害内容生成；但一个普遍却未经检验的信念是：分配更多安全推理预算、即更长的安全思考轨迹，必然带来更安全行为。本文通过严格安全评估考察安全推理预算与生成安全性的关系，尤其在对抗条件下，发现安全并不随思考轨迹变长而单调提升：对简单攻击过度思考、对困难攻击思考不足都会引入额外安全风险，导致固定预算安全策略系统性失败。受此启发，作者提出 SafeAdapt，一种自适应思考分配的安全对齐方法，学习根据提示难度动态调整推理模型的安全思考预算，从而自适应分配计算资源，而非遵循“越长越安全”的固定模式。多个对抗基准实验表明，SafeAdapt 在多样且具有挑战性的攻击设置下显著提升安全性能，并实现更理想的思考预算。

paper.title: GoodVibe: Security-by-Vibe for LLM-Based Code Generation
paper.description: Maximilian Thang, Technical University of Darmstadt; Lichao Wu, University of Bristol; Sasha Behrouzi and Mohamadreza Rostami, Technical University of Darmstadt; Jona te Lintelo, Radboud University; Stjepan Picek, University of Zagreb and Radboud University; Ahmad-Reza Sadeghi, Technical University of Darmstadt Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation in fast, informal development workflows, often referred to as vibe coding, where speed and convenience are prioritized, and security requirements are rarely made explicit. In this setting, models frequently produce functionally correct but insecure code, creating a growing security risk. Existing approaches to improving code security rely on full-parameter fine-tuning or parameter-efficient adaptations, which are either costly and prone to catastrophic forgetting or operate at coarse granularity with limited interpretability and control. We present GoodVibe, a neuron-level framework for improving the security of code language models by default. GoodVibe is based on the key insight that security-relevant reasoning is localized to a small subset of neurons. We identify these neurons using gradient-based attribution from a supervised security task and perform neuron-selective fine-tuning that updates only this security-critical subspace. To further reduce training cost, we introduce activation-driven neuron clustering, enabling structured updates with minimal overhead. We evaluate GoodVibe on six LLMs across security-critical programming languages, including C++, Java, Swift, and Go. GoodVibe substantially improves the security of generated code while preserving general model utility, achieving up to a 2.5× improvement over base models, achieving performance competitive with full fine-tuning while using over 4700× fewer trainable parameters, and reducing training computation by more than 3.6× compared to the parameter-efficient baseline (LoRA). Our results demonstrate that neuron-level optimization offers an effective and scalable approach to securing code generation without sacrificing generality.
paper.author: Maximilian Thang, Technical University of Darmstadt; Lichao Wu, University of Bristol; Sasha Behrouzi and Mohamadreza Rostami, Technical University of Darmstadt; Jona te Lintelo, Radboud University; Stjepan Picek, University of Zagreb and Radboud University; Ahmad-Reza Sadeghi, Technical University of Darmstadt
paper.summary_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多用于快速、非正式的“vibe coding”代码生成，其中速度与便利优先、安全需求很少被明确表达，模型常生成功能正确但不安全的代码，形成日益增长的安全风险。现有改进代码安全的方法依赖全参数微调或参数高效适配，前者成本高且易灾难性遗忘，后者粒度粗、可解释性和控制力有限。本文提出 GoodVibe，一个神经元级框架，基于“安全相关推理仅定位在少量神经元”的关键洞察；它利用监督安全任务的梯度归因识别这些神经元，并只对安全关键子空间进行神经元选择性微调。为进一步降低训练成本，作者引入激活驱动的神经元聚类，实现结构化更新和极小开销。作者在六种 LLM 和多种安全关键语言（包括 C++、Java、Swift、Go）上评估，GoodVibe 显著提升生成代码安全性并保持通用效用，相比基座模型最高提升 2.5 倍，性能与全量微调竞争但可训练参数少 4700 倍以上，训练计算比 LoRA 减少 3.6 倍以上，表明神经元级优化是有效且可扩展的安全代码生成方案。

paper.title: Security Tools Don't Detect Attacks—Humans Do
paper.description: Krupa Pratap Brahmkstri is a Senior Data Science Manager at Visa, where she leads the development of AI-driven cybersecurity solutions focused on identity risk modeling, insider threat detection, and security operations automation. She builds production-scale machine learning systems that analyze large volumes of enterprise security telemetry to detect anomalous behavior. She brings expertise across artificial intelligence, cybersecurity analytics, and large-scale data systems, with a focus on identity-centric defense strategies and explainable AI for security operations. As a professional mentor and speaker, she is deeply motivated by the opportunity to make a tangible impact through technology. She approaches challenges as mathematical and algorithmic problems, combining analytical rigor with creative problem-solving.
paper.author: Krupa Brahmkstri, Visa
paper.summary_zh: 该报告标题强调安全工具本身不会检测攻击，最终是人在检测攻击，安全运营应重视人类分析员的核心判断作用。讲者 Krupa Brahmkstri 是 Visa 高级数据科学经理，领导开发 AI 驱动的网络安全解决方案，聚焦身份风险建模、内部威胁检测和安全运营自动化。其工作构建生产级机器学习系统，分析大量企业安全遥测以检测异常行为，并关注身份中心防御策略和可解释 AI 在安全运营中的应用。报告从工业实践角度说明如何用 AI 辅助人类分析员，而非替代人类，从而提升安全运营检测与响应效果。

paper.title: RecStruct: Recovering Nested Struct Types from Stripped Binaries via Stack-Driven Unification
paper.description: Recovering composite data types from stripped binaries is critical for reverse engineering and vulnerability analysis. Existing approaches either rely on heavyweight decompilers with limited type reasoning, or employ expensive constraint solvers that fail to scale. While some methods can handle nested structures, they struggle with large real-world binaries due to prohibitive computational costs. We present RecStruct, a fast type recovery framework that reconstructs nested structures without dependence on any decompiler. RecStruct lifts binaries directly, performs flow-insensitive symbolic execution to reduce memory aliases, and introduces Stack-Driven Unification—a novel union-find algorithm that maintains an offset stack during traversal to merge types only when their nesting depths align. This enables precise recovery of recursive structures. We implement an end-to-end pipeline and evaluate it on 418 binaries comprising 744,770 functions, including benchmarks from prior work and large-scale programs such as QEMU and OpenSSL. Experimental results demonstrate competitive accuracy compared to existing tools, with substantial improvements in efficiency and scalability, enabling analysis of binaries that were previously intractable.
paper.author: Yuxin Chen, Zhiyang Fang, Shiyi Wu, Yixin Xu, and Yuhang Wang, Sichuan University; Xiaokang Yin, Information Engineering University; Junfeng Wang, Sichuan University
paper.summary_zh: 从剥离符号的二进制中恢复嵌套复合数据类型对逆向工程和漏洞分析至关重要，但现有方法依赖重型反编译器或昂贵的约束求解器，难以扩展到大型真实程序。本文提出 RecStruct，一种不依赖反编译器的快速类型恢复框架，直接提升二进制并执行流不敏感符号执行以降低内存别名影响。其核心是 Stack-Driven Unification：一种新的并查集算法，在遍历时维护偏移栈，仅当类型的嵌套深度一致时才合并，从而精确恢复递归结构。作者在包含 744,770 个函数的 418 个二进制（包括 QEMU 和 OpenSSL 等大型程序）上评估，显示精度与现有工具相当，但在效率和可扩展性上显著提升，使此前难以分析的二进制成为可行。

paper.title: BlockMeNot: Automatic Selection of Domain and URL Blocking Granularity to Minimize Collateral Damage and Evasion
paper.description: Domain and URL blocking is a fundamental mechanism for mitigating malicious, illegal, and inappropriate online content. Yet, selecting the right blocking granularity remains a largely unexplored problem. Overblocking can cause severe collateral damage if the content to be blocked uses the infrastructure of benign services, which may be unintentionally disrupted. Underblocking instead enables trivial evasion. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a novel approach that, given a domain or URL to be blocked, automatically selects the most appropriate blocking granularity (URL, subdomain, or apex) to minimize collateral damage and evasion opportunities. At the core of our approach are two novel machine learning classifiers to identify URL-leasing and subdomain-leasing apexes. The classifiers are trained and evaluated using a manually labeled dataset of 10,843 apexes, achieving F1 scores over 0.9. We implement our approach into BlockMeNot, a tool for identifying potential collateral damage prior to enforcement. We evaluate BlockMeNot on 225,355 entries (i.e., domains and URLs) collected from six blocklists and two threat exchanges. Although only 2.6% of apexes belong to leasers, they host 34.7% of the entries, and up to 71.7% in phishing-focused blocklists, underscoring the importance of fine-grained blocking. BlockMeNot identifies 1,976 leasing apexes, 59.3% of which were not in our ground truth, demonstrating the limitations of static lists and the need for our classifiers. Only 37.2% of blocklist entries are listed at the optimal granularity, 1.3% produce collateral damage, and 61.6% enable easy evasion. Overall, our work provides the first automated solution for domain and URL blocking granularity selection and offers practical guidance for block requesters, executors, and blocklist maintainers.
paper.author: Daud Ahmed, IMDEA Software Institute and Universidad Politécnica de Madrid; Srdjan Matic, Universidad Carlos III de Madrid; Platon Kotzias and Emiliano Carlesi, BforeAI; Juan Caballero, IMDEA Software Institute
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究域名和 URL 封禁中的粒度选择问题。封禁粒度过粗可能因共享基础设施而对良性服务造成严重附带损害，粒度过细则容易被攻击者绕过。作者提出一种自动选择最合适封禁粒度（URL、子域名或顶级域）的方法，以最小化附带损害和规避机会。方法核心是两个机器学习分类器，用于识别 URL 租赁型和子域名租赁型顶级域；在人工标注的 10,843 个顶级域数据集上训练评估，F1 超过 0.9。作者实现 BlockMeNot 工具，并在来自六个黑名单和两个威胁交换的 225,355 条域名/URL 上评估：仅 2.6% 的顶级域属于租赁型，却托管了 34.7% 的条目，钓鱼黑名单中高达 71.7%；BlockMeNot 识别出 1,976 个租赁型顶级域，其中 59.3% 不在真值中；只有 37.2% 的黑名单条目处于最优粒度，1.3% 会造成附带损害，61.6% 容易被规避。

paper.title: SPIRIT: Batch Hintless Single-Server PIR via Stateful Ciphertext Conversion
paper.description: Zhou Zhang, Ran Mao, Zian Zhao, Haowen Pan, Yunhao Fu, Yizhong Liu, and Dawei Li, School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang University; Yi Chen, Bo Zhang, Changrui Ren, and Jin Dong, Beijing Academy of Blockchain and Edge Computing; Zhenyu Guan and Song Bian, School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang University This work proposes a single-server private information retrieval (PIR) protocol for the efficient evaluation of batched queries without offline hints. It has recently been shown that hintless PIR can be established through the cross-scheme ciphertext conversion technique. However, we point out that such a conversion introduces a considerable amount of computational and communication overheads in the batch PIR setting. To tackle the performance challenge, we propose SPIRIT, a batch, hintless, and single-server PIR protocol that leverages stateful ciphertext conversion to simultaneously achieve high-throughput query execution and low communication cost. To enhance computational efficiency, we develop a novel stateful key expansion procedure that amortizes the conversion cost across multiple queries, significantly accelerating the query evaluation speed. To reduce the communication overhead, we derive a new response compression strategy based on a shared intermediate representation, such that a batch of PIR responses can be packed into a single ciphertext efficiently. In experiments, we show that SPIRIT can achieve up to by 3.1×−5.1× speedup in query execution and reduce the communication bandwidth by 2.3×−3.6× compared to state-of-the-art batch PIR protocols.
paper.author: Zhou Zhang, Ran Mao, Zian Zhao, Haowen Pan, Yunhao Fu, Yizhong Liu, and Dawei Li, School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang University; Yi Chen, Bo Zhang, Changrui Ren, and Jin Dong, Beijing Academy of Blockchain and Edge Computing; Zhenyu Guan and Song Bian, School of Cyber Science and Technology, Beihang University
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究单服务器、无离线提示的批量私有信息检索（PIR）效率问题。现有无提示 PIR 可通过跨方案密文转换实现，但在批量查询场景下会带来显著计算和通信开销。作者提出 SPIRIT，利用有状态密文转换同时实现高吞吐查询与低通信成本：设计有状态密钥扩展过程将转换开销摊销到多次查询，并基于共享中间表示提出新的响应压缩策略，把一批 PIR 响应高效打包进单个密文。实验表明，SPIRIT 相比最先进的批量 PIR 协议可将查询执行速度提升 3.1–5.1 倍，并将通信带宽降低 2.3–3.6 倍。

paper.title: Your Keywords Know Each Other: Breaking SSE with <1% Leaked Documents
paper.description: Searchable symmetric encryption (SSE) schemes inevitably leak search, access, and volume patterns, which adversaries can exploit along with partial knowledge of the data to recover documents and queries. Prior passive attacks rely on document-keyword occurrence matching, but under realistic low leakage, many keywords induce identical patterns, forming large ambiguous groups that sharply limit recovery. We observe this failure arises from missing relational signals among keywords. Keywords, however, exhibit stable semantic regularities across corpora even when direct co-occurrence is sparse, allowing external linguistic knowledge to augment observed leakage. Based on this insight, we present Whisper, a staged co-occurrence augmented query recovery framework that weaves LLM-synthesized corpora with pre-trained embeddings to densify co-occurrence matrices and disambiguate otherwise indistinguishable candidates. We evaluate Whisper on six diverse real-world datasets, including three collected in late 2025 to test generalization beyond LLM training cutoffs. At 0.1% leakage, previously considered safe, Whisper boosts correct query recovery from 1727% under current SOTA to 36–49% across all datasets, a 22.5× improvement. Even at 1% leakage, Whisper approaches near-complete recovery, exceeding 80% on most datasets and peaking at 95%, while remaining effective against padding and volume hiding defenses, exposing a previously underestimated vulnerability in SSE.
paper.author: Mingyu Bian, Jiabei Wang, Dandan Xu, Guangyu Huang, and Yongbin Zhou, School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Nanjing University of Science and Technology
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究可搜索对称加密（SSE）中的被动查询恢复攻击。SSE 会泄漏搜索、访问和体积模式，现有攻击依赖文档-关键词共现匹配，但在真实低泄漏场景下许多关键词产生相同模式，形成大型歧义组，严重限制恢复效果。作者发现关键词之间存在稳定语义规律，即使直接共现稀疏，也可用外部语言知识增强观测泄漏。为此提出 Whisper，一个分阶段、共现增强的查询恢复框架，利用 LLM 合成语料与预训练嵌入稠密化共现矩阵，从而区分原本不可区分的候选。在六个真实数据集上，当泄漏率仅 0.1% 时，Whisper 将正确查询恢复率从当前最优方法的低个位数百分比提升到 36%–49%（提升约 22.5 倍）；在 1% 泄漏率下多数数据集超过 80%，最高达 95%，且对填充和体积隐藏防御仍有效。

paper.title: Non-Interactive Key Exchange from Lattices in the Standard Model
paper.description: Existing non-interactive key exchange (NIKE) constructions in the CKS-heavy security model either incur loose security reductions or lack lattice instantiations due to the absence of suitable hash proof systems (HPS). To overcome this limitation, we introduce a new cryptographic primitive, named as decoupled key encapsulation mechanisms (decoupled KEMs), which separates recipient-independent ciphertext generation from recipient-specific key derivation. Moreover, we formalize the security of our decoupled KEM as MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+, which is a multi-user security notion. Based on this, we give a new framework that any decoupled KEM with MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+ implies a NIKE protocol with much tighter security in the CKS-heavy security model. For concrete instantiation, we first construct a specific HPS based on Modulus-LWE in the standard model, and then obtain a decoupled KEM with the desired security notion. Applying our framework, we obtain a lattice-based NIKE secure in the standard model, denoted NIKE HPS . NIKE HPS . achieves a linear security reduction loss in the number of users and close to the known optimum, improving upon the quadratic loss of SWOOSH (USENIX Security' 24) under CKS-heavy security. Experiments show that our protocol achieves significant speedups in key generation and shared-key derivation over SWOOSH.
paper.author: Ying Li and Lei Zhang, East China Normal University; Qiqi Lai, Shaanxi Normal University
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究标准模型下基于格的非交互式密钥交换（NIKE）。现有 CKS-heavy 安全模型下的 NIKE 构造要么安全归约较松，要么因缺少合适的哈希证明系统（HPS）而无法实现格实例。作者引入“解耦密钥封装机制”（decoupled KEM），将接收者无关的密文生成与接收者相关的密钥派生分离，并形式化其多用户安全概念 MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+。基于此提出通用框架：任何满足该安全性的解耦 KEM 都可构造 CKS-heavy 模型下更紧安全的 NIKE。具体地，作者在标准模型下基于 Modulus-LWE 构造 HPS，进而得到格基 NIKE HPS，其安全归约损失随用户数线性增长，优于 SWOOSH 的二次损失，且实验显示密钥生成和共享密钥派生速度显著提升。

paper.title: DuetORAM: Two-Server Distributed ORAM with Constant Rounds and O(log N) Communication
paper.description: Feng Li and Xiangfu Song, Nanyang Technological University; Yingying Li, Hangzhou Normal University; Lisha Yao and Guomin Yang, Singapore Management University; Tianwei Zhang, Nanyang Technological University; Robert H. Deng, Singapore Management University Distributed Oblivious RAM (DORAM) is a promising building block for privacy-preserving cloud databases and outsourced storage systems. However, existing two-server designs often rely on slow linear scans or heavy cryptographic primitives, making them struggle to balance efficiency and bandwidth, and thus hindering their practical deployment. We present DuetORAM, a two-server DORAM that achieves constant-round access with O(log N) communication while avoiding these computational bottlenecks. Our key idea is a replicated-to-shared block encoding that allows servers to keep identical ciphertexts for efficient PIR-based retrieval, while locally interpreting them as secret shares to enable oblivious eviction via a lightweight shuffle. We further design a secret-shared shuffle with an offline-online decomposition that shifts most bandwidth-intensive work to a preprocessing phase, significantly reducing online communication. We implement a prototype of DuetORAM and evaluate it under diverse network conditions. Our results show that DuetORAM outperforms both the state-of-the-art two-server scheme DUORAM (reducing retrieval latency by up to 170× in LAN settings), and three-server design S^3ORAM (reducing retrieval latency by 1.7× in LAN and accelerating eviction by 7× in LAN and 5× in WAN, respectively).
paper.author: Feng Li and Xiangfu Song, Nanyang Technological University; Yingying Li, Hangzhou Normal University; Lisha Yao and Guomin Yang, Singapore Management University; Tianwei Zhang, Nanyang Technological University; Robert H. Deng, Singapore Management University
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究面向隐私保护云数据库和外包存储的分布式不经意 RAM（DORAM）。现有两服务器 DORAM 设计常依赖慢速线性扫描或重量级密码学原语，难以兼顾效率与带宽。作者提出 DuetORAM，核心是“复制到共享”的块编码：服务器可保存相同密文以支持高效 PIR 检索，同时本地将其解释为秘密共享，从而通过轻量洗牌实现不经意驱逐。论文还设计了带离线-在线分解的秘密共享洗牌，将大部分带宽密集工作转移到预处理阶段。实验表明，DuetORAM 在局域网中相比最先进两服务器方案 DUORAM 可将检索延迟降低最多 170 倍，相比三服务器方案 S^3ORAM 检索延迟降低 1.7 倍，驱逐在 LAN 和 WAN 分别加速 7 倍和 5 倍。

paper.title: HijackKV: New Threat in Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse
paper.description: Key-Value (KV) cache reduces inference latency in large language models (LLMs). Traditional prefix-based reuse has low cache hit rates across inference requests because it requires exact token and position matches. To improve efficiency, recent system optimizations introduce position-independent KV reuse, allowing KV cache to be reused whenever identical text chunks appear, regardless of their position in the sequence. We show this design introduces a new threat, KV Cache Hijacking. Since KV caches are retrieved by token match but encode the context in which they were originally computed, the KV tied to a benign-looking token chunk may encode an attacker-controlled prefix. When later reused in a victim query, this contaminated KV silently hijacks the model's behavior, even if no attacker-controlled text appears in the input. We introduce HIJACKKV, the first attack framework that systematically exploits this vulnerability, demonstrating its severity and practicality. HIJACKKV optimizes an attacker-controlled prefix, so that the KV computed for a subsequent common benign text encodes the attacker's goal, while the text remains unchanged for future cache hits. HIJACKKV achieves an average 94% success rate in a single attempt, remains effective under realistic constraints including low hit rates (10%) and frequent recomputation (50%), persists over multi-turn interactions, and transfers across models in black-box settings. We further provide design insights for building secure KV reuse systems.
paper.author: Yichi Zhang and Zhiqi Wang, The Pennsylvania State University; Huan Zhang, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Yuchen Yang, The Pennsylvania State University
paper.summary_zh: 该论文揭示了大语言模型中位置无关 KV 缓存复用带来的新威胁——KV 缓存劫持。传统基于前缀的复用要求 token 和位置完全匹配，命中率低；位置无关复用允许相同文本块在不同位置复用 KV 缓存，从而提高效率，但 KV 缓存按 token 匹配检索却编码了原始上下文。作者提出 HIJACKKV，首个系统利用该漏洞的攻击框架：优化攻击者控制的上下文前缀，使后续常见良性文本对应的 KV 编码攻击者目标，而文本本身保持不变，仍可被未来缓存命中。实验显示 HIJACKKV 单次尝试平均成功率 94%，在 10% 低命中率和 50% 频繁重算等现实约束下仍有效，可跨多轮交互持续，并能黑盒迁移到其他模型；论文还给出安全 KV 复用系统的设计建议。

paper.title: MarkNull: Model-Agnostic Watermark Removal in AI-Generated Images via On-Manifold Latent Manipulation
paper.description: Digital watermarking has emerged as a critical technique for provenance and copyright attribution in AI-generated imagery, yet its robustness against realistic, model-agnostic removal attacks remains poorly explored. Existing attacks either succeed only against specific generative models or achieve removal at the cost of severe visual degradation. In this paper, we propose MarkNull, a model-agnostic watermark removal attack via on-manifold latent manipulation. MarkNull is grounded in a key observation: watermarked images exhibit a strong statistical dependency between the generated latent representation and the embedded initial noise. To quantify this dependency, we introduce the Noise-Latent Alignment Score (NLAS) and formulate an optimization objective that selectively decorrelates the latent representation from the embedded watermark while preserving semantic fidelity. Extensive evaluations across different categories of watermarking paradigms, including post-hoc, fine-tuning-based, and initial-noise-based schemes, demonstrate that MarkNull reduces average bit accuracy to 53.14%, approaching random-guessing (50%), without perceptible image degradation. To further improve scalability, we propose MarkNull-A, an amortized, optimization-free variant that distills the attack into a single forward pass, achieving 0.50 s/image with modest computational overhead. Notably, our attacks successfully compromise Google's SynthID-Image system while preserving high visual quality and transfer effectively to video watermarking. Finally, we present an attack detection mechanism as a defensive counterpart to MarkNull and MarkNull-A, highlighting the necessity of developing watermark designs resilient to model-agnostic latent-space attacks.
paper.author: Jie Cao, Qi Li, Zelin Zhang, and Xiaodong Wu, Queen's University; Lingshuang Liu, University of Waterloo; Xiangman Li and Jianbing Ni, Queen's University
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究 AI 生成图像水印对模型无关移除攻击的鲁棒性。现有攻击要么只针对特定生成模型，要么在移除水印时造成严重视觉退化。作者提出 MarkNull，一种基于流形潜在操纵的模型无关水印移除攻击；其关键观察是带水印图像的生成潜在表示与嵌入的初始噪声之间存在强统计依赖。为此引入噪声-潜在对齐分数（NLAS），并构造优化目标，在保持语义保真度的同时选择性地解除潜在表示与水印的相关性。实验覆盖后处理式、微调式和初始噪声式水印方案，MarkNull 将平均比特准确率降至 53.14%（接近随机猜测 50%），且无可感知图像退化；MarkNull-A 将攻击蒸馏为单次前向，达到 0.50 秒/图，并成功攻击 Google SynthID-Image，还可迁移到视频水印。论文最后提出攻击检测机制，强调需要设计能抵抗模型无关潜在空间攻击的水印。

paper.title: BadGraph: Structural Knowledge Isolation Attacks against Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.description: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) improves cross-document reasoning by introducing graph structures into retrieval. However, these graph structures also expose an under-studied topological attack surface. Existing research on GraphRAG attacks primarily focuses on targeted attacks based on text or relation manipulation, which induce the model to generate specific incorrect answers by injecting factual errors. These attacks often rely on explicit false-answer payloads, poisoned relations, or corpus rewriting, and their documents can be easier to flag during content auditing. In this paper, we propose a targeted availability attack against GraphRAG: Structural Knowledge Isolation. Unlike traditional wrong-answer manipulation attacks, this attack targets the system's availability by degrading retrieval of critical evidence through topological manipulation. The resulting context can lack the evidence needed for grounded answer generation. We first mathematically analyze three topological vulnerabilities of graph algorithms used in GraphRAG systems when subjected to topological perturbations. Based on this analysis, we propose the BadGraph attack framework. By injecting a small amount of semantically neutral text, it generates adversarial subgraphs in the knowledge graph and reduces the visibility of target evidence in top-ranked retrieval contexts. Experiments show that with a small document injection budget (49 documents on HotpotQA and 30 on 2WikiMultiHopQA), BadGraph consistently lowers source recall and end-to-end QA F1 on three mainstream GraphRAG systems (MS-GraphRAG, LightRAG, and FastGraphRAG), while using neutral linker documents.
paper.author: Leiming Yan, Xinlong Xu, and Ziqiang Li, Engineering Research Center of Digital Forensics, Ministry of Education, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）中未被充分探索的拓扑攻击面。现有 GraphRAG 攻击多基于文本或关系操纵，通过注入事实错误诱导特定错误答案，往往依赖显式错误载荷、污染关系或重写语料，较易被内容审计发现。作者提出一种针对 GraphRAG 的定向可用性攻击——结构知识隔离，通过拓扑操纵降低关键证据的检索可见性，使生成上下文缺少接地答案所需证据。论文首先数学分析 GraphRAG 图算法在拓扑扰动下的三类漏洞，然后提出 BadGraph 框架，注入少量语义中性文本生成对抗子图，降低目标证据在 top-ranked 检索上下文中的可见性。实验表明，在 HotpotQA 注入 49 篇文档、2WikiMultiHopQA 注入 30 篇文档的小预算下，BadGraph 持续降低 MS-GraphRAG、LightRAG 和 FastGraphRAG 的源召回率与端到端 QA F1，且使用的链接文档语义中性。

paper.title: FragFuse: Bypassing Access Control of Large Language Model Agents via Memory-Based Query Fragmentation and Fusion
paper.description: Zixin Rao, Wentian Zhu, and Chan Aristella Lu, University of Georgia; Zhaorun Chen, University of Chicago; Wei Niu and Le Guan, University of Georgia; Bo Li, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Zhen Xiang, University of Georgia Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support complex task execution, user personalization, and domain adaptation. Meanwhile, emerging access-control mechanisms for LLM agents are being explored to block policy-violating requests, aiming to prevent misuse and improve resource efficiency. In this paper, we reveal a novel attack surface arising from agents' memory operations: prohibited content triggering access control can be fragmented across interactions, stored in long-term memory in a benign-appearing form, and later reconstructed through memory retrieval, without appearing explicitly in the final user query. Specifically, we propose FragFuse, the first attack that enables unprivileged users to bypass agent access control by exploiting this temporal channel introduced by long-term memory. FragFuse operates in three stages: (1) identifying rejection-responsible fragments via black-box adaptive querying with fragment masking; (2) injecting these fragments into memory using marked carrier queries; and (3) retrieving and fusing the stored fragments through a follow-up attack query. While FragFuse can be instantiated manually for individual agents, we propose an optimization scheme that tunes fusion instructions and marker designs on surrogate models, enabling automated attack generation without violating the attacker's threat model assumptions. We evaluate FragFuse across four representative agent settings and task domains, covering three state-of-the-art agent access-control mechanisms. FragFuse achieves an average bypass success rate of 86.3% and an average end-to-end harmful task success rate of 41.1% across all settings, with only 4.4% average task success rate degradation compared to configurations without access control. Additionally, we show that alternative defenses, such as state-of-the-art prompt-injection detectors and perplexity detectors, cannot effectively address our attack.
paper.author: Zixin Rao, Wentian Zhu, and Chan Aristella Lu, University of Georgia; Zhaorun Chen, University of Chicago; Wei Niu and Le Guan, University of Georgia; Bo Li, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Zhen Xiang, University of Georgia
paper.summary_zh: 该论文揭示 LLM 代理长期记忆机制带来的新攻击面：访问控制禁止的内容可被拆分到多次交互中，以良性形式存入长期记忆，并在后续通过记忆检索重组，而最终用户查询中不显式出现违规内容。作者提出 FragFuse，首个利用该时序通道让非特权用户绕过代理访问控制的攻击。FragFuse 分三阶段：通过带片段掩码的黑盒自适应查询识别触发拒绝的片段；用标记载体查询将片段注入记忆；再通过后续攻击查询检索并融合这些片段。论文还提出优化方案，在替代模型上调整融合指令和标记设计，实现自动化攻击生成。在四种代表性代理设置和任务领域、三种先进代理访问控制机制上，FragFuse 平均绕过成功率 86.3%，端到端有害任务成功率 41.1%，相比无访问控制配置仅下降 4.4%，且现有提示注入检测器和困惑度检测器无法有效防御。

paper.title: From Zero to Hero: Cross-modal-enhanced Adversarial Item Promotion Attack against Multimodal Recommender Systems
paper.description: Mengyu Yao, MOEKey Lab of HCST (PKU), School of Computer Science, Peking University; Ant Group; Ziqi Zhang, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Yifeng Cai and Junlin Liu, MOEKey Lab of HCST (PKU), School of Computer Science, Peking University; Xinyi Fu and Weiqiang Wang, Ant Group; Xiangqun Chen, Yao Guo, and Ding Li, MOEKey Lab of HCST (PKU), School of Computer Science, Peking University Multimodal recommender systems (MRSs) jointly leverage visual and textual item representations to determine item ranking and exposure in modern online platforms. Their strong dependence on item content, however, introduces new security risks. In particular, malicious sellers can conduct the adversarial item promotion (AIP) attack to manipulate item content to deceive the recommender into overranking specific items. When it succeeds, the promoted items gain disproportionately higher exposure, leading to significant market visibility and direct economic gain. However, existing AIP research primarily targets unimodal recommenders, leaving the unique vulnerabilities of MRSs largely unexplored. Meanwhile, multimodal adversarial attacks for vision–language models (VLMs) optimize objectives unrelated to ranking and lack cross-modal coordination unique to MRSs. To bridge this gap, we propose CREAM (CRoss-modal-Enhanced AIP attack against MRSs). Our key insight is to jointly perturb multiple modalities in a semantically consistent manner}. We integrate a tailored visual perturbator, a text generator, and a joint optimization controller to fully exploit cross-modal correlations in a black-box setting. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that CREAM significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving on average 5.75x and 2.89x higher exposure at top-10 and top-50 metrics, and demonstrates robustness under evolving real-world conditions. This exposes a tangible economic risk to recommender platforms. Meanwhile, CREAM maintains high imperceptibility across visual, textual, and cross-modal dimensions. We further investigate several potential defense strategies and demonstrate their limitations, highlighting the urgent need for stronger protections against adversarial threats in MRSs.
paper.author: Mengyu Yao, MOEKey Lab of HCST (PKU), School of Computer Science, Peking University; Ant Group; Ziqi Zhang, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Yifeng Cai and Junlin Liu, MOEKey Lab of HCST (PKU), School of Computer Science, Peking University; Xinyi Fu and Weiqiang Wang, Ant Group; Xiangqun Chen, Yao Guo, and Ding Li, MOEKey Lab of HCST (PKU), School of Computer Science, Peking University
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究多模态推荐系统（MRS）中的对抗性商品推广（AIP）攻击。MRS 联合利用视觉和文本商品表示决定排序与曝光，恶意卖家可通过篡改商品内容欺骗推荐器，使特定商品获得过高曝光和经济收益；但现有 AIP 研究主要针对单模态推荐器，而视觉-语言模型的多模态对抗攻击又与排序目标脱节，缺乏 MRS 特有的跨模态协调。作者提出 CREAM，一种跨模态增强的 MRS AIP 攻击，核心是在语义一致的前提下联合扰动多个模态，集成定制视觉扰动器、文本生成器和联合优化控制器，在黑盒设置下利用跨模态相关性。评估显示 CREAM 显著优于现有方法：在 top-10 和 top-50 指标上平均曝光分别提升 5.75 倍和 2.89 倍，并在真实演化条件下保持鲁棒，同时在视觉、文本和跨模态维度保持高不可感知性；论文还探讨多种防御策略并指出其局限性。

paper.title: Low-Cost Hard-Label Adversarial Attack with Theoretical Foundations
paper.description: Jun Liu, University of Macau; National Institute of Informatics; Leo Yu Zhang, Griffith University; Fengpeng Li, University of Macau; Isao Echizen, University of Tokyo; National Institute of Informatics; Jiantao Zhou, University of Macau Hard-label black-box attacks, relying solely on top-1 predictions, represent one of the most challenging yet practically threat models. Despite recent progress, existing approaches face two key limitations: (1) they overlook the critical role of initialization, focusing primarily on optimization strategies; and (2) they rely heavily on empirical heuristics without theoretical guarantees. To bridge this gap, we establish a unified theoretical framework showing that existing sign-flipping hard-label attacks can be understood as approximating the true gradient sign. Guided by this {principled analysis}, we propose a novel attack framework featuring a zero-query initialization strategy and a Pattern-Driven Optimization (PDO) algorithm. We provide theoretical guarantees that our initialization yields higher cosine similarity to the true gradient sign than random baselines, and our PDO module achieves significantly lower query complexity than baseline search methods. Extensive experiments across CIFAR-10, ImageNet, and ObjectNet—covering standard and adversarially trained models, commercial APIs, and CLIP models—demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms SOTA hard-label attacks in both success rate and efficiency, particularly under low query budgets. Furthermore, our method demonstrates robust generalization across corrupted data (ImageNet-C), biomedical images (PathMNIST), and dense prediction tasks such as segmentation. Notably, it bypasses the stateful defense Blacklight, achieving a 0% detection rate.
paper.author: Jun Liu, University of Macau; National Institute of Informatics; Leo Yu Zhang, Griffith University; Fengpeng Li, University of Macau; Isao Echizen, University of Tokyo; National Institute of Informatics; Jiantao Zhou, University of Macau
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究仅依赖 top-1 预测的硬标签黑盒对抗攻击。现有方法存在两个关键局限：忽视初始化的重要作用，且依赖经验启发式而缺乏理论保证。作者建立统一理论框架，表明现有符号翻转硬标签攻击可理解为对真实梯度符号的近似；在此指导下提出新攻击框架，包含零查询初始化策略和模式驱动优化（PDO）算法。理论分析保证其初始化相比随机基线具有更高余弦相似度，且 PDO 的查询复杂度显著低于基线搜索方法。在 CIFAR-10、ImageNet、ObjectNet 以及标准与对抗训练模型、商业 API 和 CLIP 模型上的实验表明，该方法在成功率和效率上持续优于 SOTA 硬标签攻击，尤其在低查询预算下；还能泛化到损坏数据（ImageNet-C）、生物医学图像（PathMNIST）和分割等密集预测任务，并绕过有状态防御 Blacklight，检测率为 0%。

paper.title: Supply Chain Attacks on Open Source: What's Happening, What Can We Do Today, and What's Next
paper.description: Zach is a Principal Security Engineer at GitHub, where he helps secure open source users and enterprise customers. In the OpenSSF he chairs the Technical Advisory Council and co-chair of the Securing Repositories Working Group which helps coordinate security improvements in programming language package repositories like PyPI and npm. Away from computers he enjoys gardening and welding.
paper.author: Zach Steindler, GitHub
paper.summary_zh: 该报告是 GitHub 安全工程师 Zach Steindler 在 USENIX Security 2026 的受邀演讲，主题聚焦开源软件供应链攻击的现状、当前可行的防御措施以及未来方向。讲者基于在 GitHub 和 OpenSSF 的工作经验，介绍如何保护开源用户与企业客户，并参与协调 PyPI、npm 等编程语言包仓库的安全改进。由于提供的描述主要是讲者简介而非论文摘要，本文没有具体实验或技术贡献，更多是行业实践与治理层面的分享。可将其视为对开源供应链安全生态、协调机制和后续行动建议的综述性报告。

paper.title: BUIzz: Finding Policy Enforcement Bugs via Interaction Simulation on the Browser User Interface
paper.description: Modern web ecosystems rely on security policy headers, such as Content Security Policy (CSP) and the SameSite cookie attribute, for client-side defenses. Because browsers enforce these headers, browser bugs in policy enforcement directly undermine these defenses. While recent studies have attempted to find such bugs, they largely overlook bugs triggered by user interactions on the browser user interface (BUI). In this paper, we propose BUIZZ, the first testing framework that identifies policy enforcement bugs triggered by BUI-level user interactions. BUIZZ first collects a comprehensive set of interactions by referencing browser manuals, right-click context menus, and known browser bugs. It then executes each interaction and their combinations on the test pages via OS-level simulation. Instead of cross-browser differential testing, BUIZZ leverages a pre/post-interaction oracle that checks for enforcement inconsistencies before and after applying interactions, enabling bug detection within a single browser. We demonstrate the efficacy of BUIZZ by finding 35 security bugs and three functional bugs across six browsers, including Chrome and Firefox. Our reports have led to fixes for 14 security bugs, resulting in seven CVEs and $14,700 in bug bounties.
paper.author: Mingi Jung, Donggyu Kim, Mijung Kim, and Seongil Wi, UNIST
paper.summary_zh: 现代 Web 生态依赖 CSP、SameSite 等安全策略头进行客户端防御，而这些策略由浏览器执行，因此浏览器在策略执行上的缺陷会直接削弱防御，但已有研究大多忽略了由浏览器用户界面（BUI）交互触发的 bug。本文提出 BUIZZ，首个针对 BUI 级用户交互所触发策略执行 bug 的测试框架：它参考浏览器手册、右键上下文菜单和已知浏览器 bug 收集全面的交互集合，通过 OS 级模拟在测试页面上执行单个交互及其组合，并采用交互前后对比 oracle 在单一浏览器内检测策略执行的不一致，而非跨浏览器差分测试。作者在包括 Chrome 和 Firefox 在内的六款浏览器中发现 35 个安全 bug 和 3 个功能 bug，其中 14 个安全 bug 已被修复，共获得 7 个 CVE 和 14,700 美元漏洞赏金。

paper.title: H3Act: Automated Measuring Semantic Conversion Anomalies of HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 Translation in CDNs
paper.description: Qihang Peng and Siyuan Tian, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, BNRist, Tsinghua University; Yongxin Qiu, Beihang University; Jinyang Huang, Central South University; Yaru Yang, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, BNRist, Tsinghua University; Xiang Li, Nankai University; Zhongguancun Laboratory; Jia Zhang, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, BNRist, Tsinghua University; Zhongguancun Laboratory; Yiming Zhang, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, BNRist, Tsinghua University; Haixin Duan, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, BNRist, Tsinghua University; Quancheng Laboratory; Yunsenxiao Lin and Shugen Chen, Tencent Technology Co., Ltd.; Liqun Yang, Beihang University Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) are adopting HTTP/3 to enhance performance; however, they often need to convert it to HTTP/1.1 for compatibility. This conversion creates significant attack surfaces and may reintroduce confirmed or even patched vulnerabilities in HTTP/2 or HTTP/1. Unfortunately, existing tools struggle to adapt to the HTTP/3 environment and efficiently leverage accumulated attack knowledge. To overcome these challenges and systematically measure HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 conversion anomalies within the black-box CDN environment, we present H3Act, a dual-agent, knowledge-driven fuzzing framework targeting HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 semantic conversion anomalies. Our approach combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to automatically transform protocol specifications and historical threat intelligence into high-precision HTTP/3 test payloads, enabling regression testing of semantic translation risks. In a large-scale study of 9 commercial CDNs, including Cloudflare, Cloudfront, and Tencent CDN, we found a significant regression in protocol security, which means vulnerabilities in old protocols are reintroduced in HTTP/3. Our research identified 7 common attack vectors across various categories, including request smuggling, cache poisoning, and Denial-of-Service (DoS) amplification. Every CDN is vulnerable to at least one attack vector. We have responsibly disclosed these vulnerabilities and have received confirmations from some vendors. These findings highlight that the CDN ecosystem currently lacks the capacity to maintain security consistency checks while pursuing improvements in protocol performance.
paper.author: Qihang Peng and Siyuan Tian, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, BNRist, Tsinghua University; Yongxin Qiu, Beihang University; Jinyang Huang, Central South University; Yaru Yang, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, BNRist, Tsinghua University; Xiang Li, Nankai University; Zhongguancun Laboratory; Jia Zhang, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, BNRist, Tsinghua University; Zhongguancun Laboratory; Yiming Zhang, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, BNRist, Tsinghua University; Haixin Duan, Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, BNRist, Tsinghua University; Quancheng Laboratory; Yunsenxiao Lin and Shugen Chen, Tencent Technology Co., Ltd.; Liqun Yang, Beihang University
paper.summary_zh: CDN 为提升性能正采用 HTTP/3，但出于兼容性往往需将其转换为 HTTP/1.1，这一转换产生了巨大攻击面，可能重新引入 HTTP/2 或 HTTP/1 中已确认甚至已修补的漏洞，而现有工具难以适应 HTTP/3 环境并高效利用积累的攻击知识。本文提出 H3Act，一个面向 HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 语义转换异常的双智能体、知识驱动模糊测试框架，它结合大语言模型（LLM）与混合检索增强生成（RAG），自动将协议规范和历史威胁情报转化为高精度 HTTP/3 测试载荷，从而对语义转换风险进行回归测试。作者对 Cloudflare、CloudFront、腾讯 CDN 等 9 个商业 CDN 开展大规模研究，发现协议安全出现明显回退，即旧协议中的漏洞在 HTTP/3 中被重新引入，共识别出请求走私、缓存投毒、DoS 放大等 7 类常见攻击向量，且每个 CDN 都至少对一种攻击向量脆弱。相关漏洞已被负责任披露并获部分厂商确认，表明 CDN 生态在追求协议性能提升时缺乏安全一致性检查能力。

paper.title: Raising the Flag: Detecting Missing Permission Controls in Mini-Program APIs
paper.description: Zhiao Wei, University of Waterloo; Chao Wang, The Ohio State University; Haseeb-Ur-Rehman Faheem, University of Waterloo; Luyi Xing, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Yousra Aafer, University of Waterloo; Zhiqiang Lin, The Ohio State University Mini-programs embedded within super-apps like WeChat have surged in popularity due to their flexibility and convenience, offering rich functionalities through underlying APIs. However, this tight integration introduces serious security risks: mini-programs often inherit the mobile operating system's permissions granted to their host super-app, potentially bypassing critical security checks. In this paper, we address the urgent need for more fine-grained access control tailored to mini-programs. We propose PERMSCOPE, a systematic framework to detect and analyze missing scope checks in mini-program APIs, revealing instances where Android permissions are implicitly inherited and exercised in mini-program APIs, i.e., cases where "ask and check'' primitives are absent. Our empirical analysis of four major super-apps reveals that 183 (8.85%) APIs are not properly protected at the mini-program API layer. We discuss the challenges underlying this issue and advocate for super-app developers to enforce fine-grained access control mechanisms at the API boundary, thereby strengthening the trustworthiness of the mobile super-app ecosystem.
paper.author: Zhiao Wei, University of Waterloo; Chao Wang, The Ohio State University; Haseeb-Ur-Rehman Faheem, University of Waterloo; Luyi Xing, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Yousra Aafer, University of Waterloo; Zhiqiang Lin, The Ohio State University
paper.summary_zh: 微信等超级应用内嵌的小程序因灵活便捷而迅速流行，并通过底层 API 提供丰富功能，但这种紧密集成带来严重安全风险：小程序常继承宿主超级应用从移动操作系统获得的权限，可能绕过关键安全检查，因此亟需针对小程序的更细粒度访问控制。本文提出 PERMSCOPE，一个系统化框架，用于检测和分析小程序 API 中缺失的作用域检查，揭示 Android 权限被隐式继承并在小程序 API 中被行使（即缺少“请求并检查”原语）的情形。作者对四款主流超级应用的实证分析发现，有 183 个（8.85%）API 未在小程序 API 层得到恰当保护。文章讨论了该问题背后的挑战，并呼吁超级应用开发者在小程序 API 边界实施细粒度访问控制，以增强移动超级应用生态的可信度。

paper.title: CULPA: Universal Detection of Memory-Safety Bugs in Unsafe Rust Through the Lens of Safety Requirements
paper.description: Rust has emerged as a leading system programming language by providing strong compile-time guarantees for memory safety. However, these guarantees do not extend to unsafe Rust, where developers may bypass compiler checks and inadvertently introduce memory-safety vulnerabilities. Although prior static analyzers have made progress in detecting such bugs, existing approaches are often fragmented: they target specific coding patterns or bug classes without modeling the underlying causes of unsafety. In this paper, we present CULPA, a universal detector for memory-safety bugs in Rust programs. The key insight of CULPA is to detect the root cause of such bugs: the violation of safety requirements in unsafe Rust contexts. To do so, CULPA first transforms the safety requirements in the standard library documentation into machine-executable predicates. Then it constructs the distinct memory segments to comply with safety requirements. Finally, CULPA collects all safety-relevant safeguards to construct the Requirement Graph. Based on the requirement graph traversal, we can determine whether violations inside unsafe blocks can be triggered. CULPA covers existing bug classes addressed by four prior static analyzers and identifies additional memory-safety vulnerabilities beyond their scope. We evaluate CULPA on the top 1,000 Rust packages. CULPA uncovers 55 previously unknown (zero-day) memory-safety bugs, 29 of which have been confirmed by developers. Most of these vulnerabilities are missed by four state-of-the-art Rust static analyzers and one LLM-based tool. To date, we have received five RustSec IDs and one CVE ID.
paper.author: Hung-Mao Chen and Bo Lu, George Mason University; Xu He, Visa Inc.; Xiaokuan Zhang and Kun Sun, George Mason University
paper.summary_zh: Rust 凭借编译期内存安全保障成为主流系统编程语言，但这些保证并不覆盖 unsafe Rust，开发者可能绕过编译器检查而引入内存安全漏洞；现有静态分析器较为碎片化，往往只针对特定编码模式或 bug 类别，未对不安全性的根因进行建模。本文提出 CULPA，一个通用的 Rust 内存安全 bug 检测器，其核心思想是检测这类 bug 的根因——unsafe 上下文中安全需求的违反：它先将标准库文档中的安全需求转化为机器可执行谓词，再构造符合安全要求的内存段，最后收集所有安全相关保护措施构建 Requirement Graph，通过图遍历判断 unsafe 块内的违反是否可被触发。CULPA 覆盖了此前四个静态分析器处理的所有 bug 类别，并能发现其范围之外的漏洞；在排名前 1000 的 Rust 包上评估，共发现 55 个此前未知的（零日）内存安全 bug，其中 29 个已被开发者确认，并获得 5 个 RustSec ID 和 1 个 CVE ID，多数漏洞被四个最先进的 Rust 静态分析器和一个基于 LLM 的工具漏掉。

paper.title: Wormholes in the File System: Understanding the Misunderstanding of Symlinks
paper.description: Symlinks, a file system feature supported at the operating system level for more than four decades, are deeply integrated across the software stack, making them an indispensable component of modern computing environments. The symlink mechanism is highly flexible, allowing references to nearly any location in the file system and enabling complex resolution behaviors. However, this flexibility also introduces significant misunderstandings for developers, which has led to widespread misuse and become a primary vector for critical security vulnerabilities in file-handling software, e.g., arbitrary file write and code execution. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of how symlinks are incorrectly handled and the substantial security risks. Specifically, we study how programming language standard libraries improperly utilize symlink-related system calls, and how such misuse and misunderstanding propagates to downstream applications which results in various inadequate path validations. To further understand whether these inadequate path validations could be exploited in real world, we design and implement five path validation bypass schemes and three arbitrary write methods. Our evaluation across 85 projects uncovered 16 arbitrary file write vulnerabilities, two of which have been assigned high-severity CVEs. We also demonstrate their severe impacts in real-world scenarios and propose multiple mitigation strategies. We have responsibly disclosed these issues to the affected vendors.
paper.author: Yongheng Liu, Lei Zhang, Yuhang Zhao, and Yuzhou He, Fudan University
paper.summary_zh: 符号链接是操作系统层面支持四十余年的文件系统特性，已深度集成于整个软件栈，但其高度灵活性允许引用文件系统中几乎任意位置并支持复杂解析行为，导致开发者普遍误解，进而造成广泛误用，成为文件处理软件中任意文件写入和代码执行等严重漏洞的主要来源。本文首次系统研究符号链接被错误处理的方式及其重大安全风险，重点分析编程语言标准库如何不当使用符号链接相关系统调用，以及这种误用和误解如何传播到下游应用，导致各种不当的路径校验。为进一步验证这些不当路径校验能否在真实世界被利用，作者设计并实现了五种路径校验绕过方案和三种任意写方法。在 85 个项目上的评估共发现 16 个任意文件写入漏洞，其中两个被分配高危 CVE；文章还展示了这些漏洞在真实场景中的严重影响并提出多种缓解策略，相关问题已负责任地披露给受影响厂商。

paper.title: SoK: Deep Learning-based Physical Side-channel Analysis
paper.description: Deep learning-based side-channel analysis (DLSCA) represents a powerful paradigm for running side-channel attacks. DLSCA, in a state-of-the-art setting, can break multiple targets with a single attack trace, requiring minimal feature engineering. As such, DLSCA is an extremely active research area for both industry and academia. At the same time, due to domain activity, it becomes more difficult to understand the current trends and challenges. In this systematization of knowledge, we provide a critical overview of developments in DLSCA over the past years, enabling us to offer concrete suggestions and taxonomies. Moreover, we examine the reproducibility perspective and show that achieving it in full is difficult and requires a careful experimental setup.
paper.author: Sengim Karayalcin, Leiden University; Marina Krček, Radboud University; Stjepan Picek, University of Zagreb Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing & Radboud University
paper.summary_zh: 基于深度学习的侧信道分析（DLSCA）是执行物理侧信道攻击的强大范式，在最先进设置下甚至可用单条攻击迹线攻破多个目标，且几乎不需要特征工程，因此成为工业界与学术界极为活跃的研究方向。然而领域的高度活跃使得把握当前趋势与挑战变得愈发困难。本文作为一篇系统化知识（SoK）工作，对过去数年 DLSCA 的发展进行了批判性回顾，据此给出具体建议与分类法。文章还从可复现性视角进行考察，指出在实践中完全实现可复现性十分困难，需要精心设计的实验设置。

paper.title: Charting the Cache Side-Channel Frontier: A Systematic Study of Eviction Set Construction on Apple Silicon
paper.description: Eviction sets constitute the fundamental primitive for conflict-based cache side-channel attacks, enabling unprivileged adversaries to induce contention deterministically. However, the security landscape of Apple Silicon remains largely underexplored due to the challenges of constructing these sets. We conduct a systematic reverse engineering study on the Apple M4 to uncover the root causes of these limitations, key microarchitectural impediments: an SLC victim buffer that obscures latency-based verification, a DRAM-to-Cache Prefetcher (DCP) that violates strict LRU replacement, and an opaque SLC allocation policy modulated by L2 Insertion/Promotion Vectors (IPV). Guided by these insights, we optimize construction strategies to overcome these impediments. Our enhanced Prime-Prune-Probe (PPP) achieves 88.2% success rate for L2 eviction sets. Furthermore, we employ a hierarchical filtering strategy to construct the first practical fine-grained SLC eviction sets on Apple Silicon. Our SLC optimal approach achieves a 90% success rate, unlocking fine-grained cross-cluster attack primitives previously deemed infeasible.
paper.author: Han Wang, Yakun Wu, Yusi Feng, and Yinqian Zhang, Southern University of Science and Technology
paper.summary_zh: 驱逐集是冲突型缓存侧信道攻击的基础原语，使非特权攻击者能够确定性地制造缓存竞争，但 Apple Silicon 的安全图景因驱逐集构造困难而长期缺乏探索。本文对 Apple M4 开展系统化逆向工程研究，揭示造成这些困难的根因性微架构障碍：SLC victim buffer 会掩盖基于延迟的验证、DRAM-to-Cache 预取器（DCP）违反严格 LRU 替换策略、以及由 L2 插入/提升向量（IPV）调节的不透明 SLC 分配策略。基于这些洞见，作者优化了构造策略：增强的 Prime-Prune-Probe（PPP）方法对 L2 驱逐集达到 88.2% 成功率；并采用分层过滤策略在 Apple Silicon 上构造出首个实用的细粒度 SLC 驱逐集，最优方法成功率达 90%，从而解锁了此前被认为不可行的细粒度跨簇攻击原语。

paper.title: JScamd: An Automated Static Taint Analysis Framework for Detecting Cryptographic API Misuses in JavaScript
paper.description: Shijie Jia, State Key Laboratory of Cyberspace Security Defense, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Bowen Xu, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Ningbo University; Yuan Ma, Yingjiao Niu, Limin Liu, and Daren Zha, State Key Laboratory of Cyberspace Security Defense, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Jingqiang Lin, School of Cyber Security, University of Science and Technology of China Cryptographic APIs are essential to application security, yet frequent developer misuse leads to widespread vulnerabilities. Detecting cryptographic misuse in JavaScript is challenging due to its dynamic semantics and fragmented cryptographic library ecosystem, which hinder static analysis tools from accurately modeling data flows and covering non-standard or evolving libraries, leading to high false-negative rates. In this paper, we propose JScamd, a static analysis framework for scalable detection of cryptographic misuse in JavaScript. JScamd integrates an enhanced program representation engine, an LLM-assisted taint rule generation pipeline, and a precise static taint analysis engine to address JavaScript dynamic features. Building upon 16 systematically defined cryptographic security constraints, JScamd automatically analyzes cryptographic APIs, identifies security-sensitive taint sources and sinks, and synthesizes comprehensive taint analysis rules. This design enables accurate detection of cryptographic misuse across diverse JavaScript libraries and application scenarios. We performed a comprehensive large-scale evaluation on 322 widely adopted JavaScript projects. JScamd detects 1,059 misuses and achieves 97.78% precision, significantly outperforming three state-of-the-art tools. Our analysis further uncovers previously unknown vulnerabilities, resulting in 41 assigned CVEs. These results demonstrate that JScamd effectively bridges cryptographic security specifications and ecosystem-scale vulnerability detection in JavaScript.
paper.author: Shijie Jia, State Key Laboratory of Cyberspace Security Defense, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Bowen Xu, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Ningbo University; Yuan Ma, Yingjiao Niu, Limin Liu, and Daren Zha, State Key Laboratory of Cyberspace Security Defense, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Jingqiang Lin, School of Cyber Security, University of Science and Technology of China
paper.summary_zh: 密码学 API 对应用安全至关重要，但开发者频繁误用导致大量漏洞；由于 JavaScript 的动态语义和碎片化的密码库生态，静态分析工具难以准确建模数据流、覆盖非标准或不断演进的密码库，导致检测漏报率高。本文提出 JScamd，一个可扩展检测 JavaScript 密码学误用的静态分析框架，集成增强的程序表示引擎、LLM 辅助的污点规则生成流水线以及精确的静态污点分析引擎，以应对 JavaScript 的动态特性。基于 16 条系统定义的密码学安全约束，JScamd 能自动分析密码 API、识别安全敏感的污点源与汇聚点并合成完整的污点分析规则，从而在多样化的 JavaScript 库和应用场景中准确检测密码学误用。作者在 322 个广泛使用的 JavaScript 项目上开展大规模评估，共检测出 1,059 处误用，精确率达 97.78%，显著优于三个最先进工具，并进一步发现此前未知的漏洞，获得 41 个分配的 CVE，表明 JScamd 有效弥合了密码学安全规范与生态级漏洞检测之间的鸿沟。

paper.title: BenchChecker: Assessing the Credibility of Bug-Fixing Benchmarks for LLMs
paper.description: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for Automatic Program Repair (APR), existing benchmarks suffer from data contamination, in which test samples appear in training sets, artificially inflating performance. To address this, we propose BenchChecker, a framework compatible with both open-source and closed-source models that supports more credible evaluation by detecting such contamination. Grounded in the observation that persistent patches likely remain in recent repository snapshots used for training, BenchChecker employs a forensics-based two-stage detection process using only textual model outputs together with public repository history. The first stage conducts a repository presence test by probing the model with code prefixes to infer training inclusion; the second stage performs a patch presence test to verify patch persistence via similarity alignment and test-suite verification. Evaluations using StarCoder-15B, StarCoder2-15B, and CodeGen2-16B trained on The Stack v2 demonstrate that BenchChecker achieves robust detection with AUC scores around 0.9 across six benchmarks. Furthermore, applying BenchChecker to SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench reveals that filtering contaminated samples reduces the reported resolution rates of most LLMs by more than 20% relative to the original rates on medium-difficulty tasks.
paper.author: Di Wu and Xu He, George Mason University; Shu Wang, Palo Alto Networks, Inc.; Kun Sun, George Mason University
paper.summary_zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在自动程序修复（APR）上展现出前景，但现有基准普遍存在数据污染问题，即测试样本出现在训练集中，从而人为夸大模型性能。为支持更可信的评估，本文提出 BenchChecker，一个同时兼容开源与闭源模型的污染检测框架。其核心观察是：持久存在的补丁很可能仍留在用于训练的最新仓库快照中；据此 BenchChecker 采用基于取证的两阶段检测流程，仅使用模型文本输出与公开仓库历史：第一阶段通过用代码前缀探测模型来推断其训练包含情况（仓库存在性测试），第二阶段通过相似度对齐和测试套件验证补丁的持久性（补丁存在性测试）。在基于 The Stack v2 训练的 StarCoder-15B、StarCoder2-15B 和 CodeGen2-16B 上的评估显示，BenchChecker 在六个基准上取得约 0.9 的 AUC，检测稳健；将其应用于 SWE-bench Verified 和 Multi-SWE-bench 后发现，过滤污染样本会使多数 LLM 在中难度任务上的报告解决率相比原始结果下降 20% 以上。

paper.title: Meerkat: Pushing the Practical Limits of Dynamic Bisection with PoC Mutation
paper.description: Once a Linux kernel bug is identified, the developers perform the difficult task of patching it. Triage tools such as Syz-bisect provide a form of root cause analysis called bisection, which systematically checks historical kernel commits for the presence of the bug until it determines the Bug-Introducing Commit (BiC). Unfortunately, Syz-bisect correctly identifies the BiC for only 35% of bugs. In order to improve Syz-bisect while remaining within its time and resource constraints, we identify three areas where Syz-bisect could be improved: bug deduplication, the use of all available PoCs, and PoC mutation. Our solution Meerkat is the first dynamic bisection tool to apply scalable PoC mutation, improving over Syz-bisect by 64%. Through an in-depth manual analysis of Meerkat's bisection results, we find that dynamic bisection is critically limited by bug detectors changing with kernel versions, changes near the buggy code, and unrelated bugs that block dynamic analysis. Based on the nature of these issues, we argue that Meerkat is approaching the practical limits of what is possible with dynamic bisection in the real world. Furthermore, we correct the ground truth for 13 bugs, thus improving the dataset for future research.
paper.author: Joseph Bursey, Christoph Sendner, and Ardalan Amiri Sani, UC Irvine; Zhiyun Qian, UC Riverside Distinguished Artifact Award Winner
paper.summary_zh: 在 Linux 内核 bug 被发现后，开发者需要完成艰难的修复工作，而 Syz-bisect 等分诊工具通过二分法系统检查历史内核提交来判断 bug 是否存在，从而定位引入 bug 的提交（BiC），但 Syz-bisect 仅对 35% 的 bug 能正确定位 BiC。为在同等时间和资源约束下改进 Syz-bisect，作者识别出 bug 去重、充分利用所有可用 PoC 以及 PoC 变异三个可改进方向，并提出 Meerkat——首个应用可扩展 PoC 变异的动态二分工具。结果显示 Meerkat 相比 Syz-bisect 提升 64%；通过对其二分结果的人工深入分析，作者发现动态二分受到内核版本间错误检测器变化、buggy 代码附近改动以及无关 bug 阻塞动态分析等关键限制，据此认为 Meerkat 已接近现实世界中动态二分所能达到的实用极限。此外，该工作还修正了 13 个 bug 的 ground truth，从而改善了供未来研究使用的数据集。

paper.title: Firmenstein: Scaling Dynamic Analysis for Linux-Based Firmware Services via API-Centric Intervention Code Synthesis
paper.description: Yanzhong Wang, Wenhui Zhang, Ruigang Liang, Kai Chen, Yi Yang, and Zhiyu Zhang, State Key Laboratory of Cyberspace Security Defense, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Junyan Jiang, School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences The rapid proliferation of Linux-based IoT devices necessitates rigorous security analysis. To achieve scalable, hardware-free analysis, firmware rehosting has become essential for constructing faithful emulated environments. However, existing approaches rely on inflexible heuristics to perform semantic-agnostic interventions, failing to generalize to diverse targets and leaving many firmware samples unanalyzable. In this paper, we propose FIRMENSTEIN, a novel API-centric framework that unifies the complex and cumbersome rehosting process into a systematic program analysis and synthesis task. Specifically, we introduce an agentic cross-program analysis built upon the API Dependency Graph to automatically diagnose rehosting roadblocks. Guided by these diagnostics, FIRMENSTEIN further introduces a roadblock-driven workflow to synthesize high-fidelity intervention code that resolves environmental dependencies, thereby enabling successful firmware execution. Evaluation on an LFwC-based dataset demonstrates that FIRMENSTEIN enables 2.5×, 3.1×, and 2.1× more firmware samples to reach interact states than the state-of-the-art rehosting tools Greenhouse, FirmAE, and Penguin, respectively. Even with incomplete rehosting, FIRMENSTEIN executes 29% more basic blocks than Greenhouse. Furthermore, FIRMENSTEIN executes 5.2% more basic blocks than Greenhouse in interactive testing, validates 29 out of 31 known N-day vulnerabilities, and facilitates the discovery of 43 previously unknown vulnerabilities, with 19 CVE IDs assigned to date.
paper.author: Yanzhong Wang, Wenhui Zhang, Ruigang Liang, Kai Chen, Yi Yang, and Zhiyu Zhang, State Key Laboratory of Cyberspace Security Defense, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Junyan Jiang, School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
paper.summary_zh: 基于 Linux 的物联网设备迅速普及，对其开展严格安全分析十分必要；固件重宿主（rehosting）是实现可扩展、无硬件依赖分析并构建可信模拟环境的关键，但现有方法依赖僵化的启发式执行语义无关的干预，难以泛化到多样目标，导致大量固件样本无法被分析。本文提出 FIRMENSTEIN，一个以 API 为中心的新型框架，将复杂繁琐的重宿主过程统一为系统化的程序分析与综合任务：它引入基于 API 依赖图（ADG）的智能体式跨程序分析来自动诊断重宿主障碍，并据此采用障碍驱动的工作流合成高保真干预代码以解决环境依赖，从而实现固件成功执行。在基于 LFwC 的数据集上评估表明，FIRMENSTEIN 使进入可交互状态的固件样本数分别比 Greenhouse、FirmAE、Penguin 多 2.5 倍、3.1 倍和 2.1 倍；即便在不完整重宿主情况下，其执行的基本块仍比 Greenhouse 多 29%，在交互测试中多执行 5.2% 的基本块，验证了 31 个已知 N-day 漏洞中的 29 个，并促成发现 43 个此前未知的漏洞，其中 19 个已获 CVE 编号。

paper.title: InSPECtor: Improving SLEIGH Specification Veracity via Proxy
paper.description: Processor specifications underpin critical security and program-analysis tools such as disassemblers, decompilers, and emulators, yet, their correctness is rarely examined. Errors in specifications distort program behaviour, obscure vulnerabilities, and enable analysis-evasion techniques. Validating processor specifications is a non-trivial task. Our study is a significant undertaking to enable, for the first time, the systematic validation of open-source SLEIGH language specifications, predominantly used by Ghidra. We design and implement a testing framework based on an automated oracle validation strategy by proxy . Our approach leverages the structure encoded in a specification itself to enumerate decodable instruction forms and generate targeted initial states. Then differentially test the successful decoding and emulation of those instructions by comparing emulators exercising the processor specification against hardware references. Applying InSPECtor across diverse, open-source specifications—x86-64, AArch64, ARM/Thumb, RISC-V, MSP430—embedding differences in specification styles, author preferences, and instruction set architecture designs, we uncovered over 38,900 discrepancies that led to 125 unique bugs with proposed fixes, identifying decoding and semantic defects as well as cross-vendor inconsistencies. We distill our findings into 8 concrete recommendations to drive future improvements. Our work underscores the importance of specification correctness and provides a practical tool to substantially improve the fidelity of SLEIGH processor specifications, strengthening the reliability of downstream security and analysis tools.
paper.author: Michael Chesser, Adelaide University; Paul Quirk, Defence Science and Technology Group; Douglas Cooke and Guy Farrelly, Adelaide University; Surya Nepal, CSIRO; Damith C. Ranasinghe, Adelaide University
paper.summary_zh: 处理器规范是反汇编器、反编译器和模拟器等关键安全与程序分析工具的基石，但其正确性很少受到检验，规范中的错误会扭曲程序行为、掩盖漏洞并为分析规避技术提供便利，而验证处理器规范本身是一项非平凡任务。本文开展了开创性研究，首次实现对开源 SLEIGH 语言规范（主要供 Ghidra 使用）的系统化验证，设计并实现了基于“代理 oracle 验证”策略的自动化测试框架：利用规范自身编码的结构枚举可解码的指令形式并生成有针对性的初始状态，再通过将执行该规范的模拟器与硬件参考进行差分测试，验证这些指令能否被成功解码与模拟。作者将 InSPECtor 应用于 x86-64、AArch64、ARM/Thumb、RISC-V、MSP430 等风格、作者偏好和 ISA 设计各异的开源规范，发现超过 38,900 处差异，归结为 125 个独特 bug 并给出修复建议，涵盖解码与语义缺陷以及跨厂商不一致，最终提炼出 8 条具体改进建议，凸显了规范正确性的重要性并为提升 SLEIGH 规范保真度提供了实用工具。

paper.title: microSCALE: Static Analysis for Microarchitectural Side-channel Leakage Evaluation
paper.description: Developing cryptographic implementations that are resistant to side-channel attacks is challenging in modern CPUs. Data-dependent switching activity induces subtle transitions deep in the microarchitecture that can cause sensitive information to leak through the CPU's power consumption. Existing leakage detection tools largely rely on simulation-based testing, which is not only time-consuming but is also limited to the explored execution scenarios. We present microSCALE, a fully automated framework for detecting power side-channel leakages that occur due to transitions in the CPU's microarchitecture. By statically analyzing the CPU's RTL, microSCALE enables systematic exploration of microarchitectural leakage sources within seconds. It precisely localizes the origin of leakage in the hardware and traces it back to the corresponding software instructions. We evaluate microSCALE on several protected crypto-implementations, including GIFT, ASCON, PRESENT, and AES, running on an open-source RISC-V processor, and identify several leakage sources. For instance, we identify that a protected implementation of the GIFT cipher has about 80% of its instructions that leak on the Rocket Core. We show how microSCALE can help in hardening this implementation, reducing the side-channel leakage around 90.3%.
paper.author: Akshay Kumar E, Pranav Krishna N, Annapurna Valiveti, Pallavi Borkar, Aditi Roy, and Chester Rebeiro, IIT Madras
paper.summary_zh: 现代CPU中数据相关的开关活动会在微架构深处产生功耗侧信道泄漏，而现有检测工具多依赖耗时且覆盖有限的仿真测试。microSCALE是一个全自动框架，通过静态分析CPU的RTL来系统探索微架构功耗侧信道泄漏源，并能将泄漏精确定位到硬件来源并回溯到对应软件指令。作者在开源RISC-V Rocket Core上评估了GIFT、ASCON、PRESENT和AES等受保护密码实现，发现多个泄漏源，例如受保护GIFT实现中约80%的指令会泄漏。microSCALE还可指导加固，使该实现的侧信道泄漏降低约90.3%。

paper.title: Spectre on RISC-V Silicon: Attacks and Defenses on Commercial Out-of-Order Processors
paper.description: Speculative execution attacks have been extensively studied on mainstream x86 and ARM architectures. However, on RISC-V, research has mostly concentrated on open-source academic designs. Commercially available RISC-V silicon is widely perceived as too simple to be vulnerable, and as a result, no end-to-end attacks have been demonstrated on real hardware to date and essential software such as the Linux kernel remains unmitigated. In this paper, we challenge that assumption. We systematically assess all commercially available out-of-order RISC-V processors (SiFive P550 and T-Head Xuantie C910/C920), finding them vulnerable to a range of Spectre attacks, and demonstrate the first Spectre attack leaking arbitrary kernel memory on real RISC-V hardware. Concerningly, our analysis reveals that mitigations in compilers, operating systems, and applications remain largely absent, and that the RISC-V instruction set lacks a dedicated speculation barrier. As a stopgap solution, we empirically characterize which instructions can halt speculation on commercial processors. We additionally audit the Linux kernel for Spectre gadgets and contribute patches, several of which have been accepted upstream. Finally, we evaluate and benchmark software-based Spectre mitigations and derive recommendations for the evolving RISC-V ecosystem, laying the groundwork for securing real hardware as it enters security-critical deployments.
paper.author: Lukas Gerlach, CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security; Marton Bognar, DistriNet, KU Leuven; Daniel Weber and Michael Schwarz, CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security; Jo Van Bulck, DistriNet, KU Leuven
paper.summary_zh: 已有推测执行攻击研究主要针对x86和ARM，而RISC-V方面多关注开源学术设计，商用RISC-V芯片常被认为过于简单而不易受攻击，因此尚无真实硬件端到端攻击且Linux内核等软件仍缺乏缓解。本文系统评估了所有商用乱序RISC-V处理器（SiFive P550与T-Head Xuantie C910/C920），发现它们易受多种Spectre攻击，并首次在真实RISC-V硬件上演示了可泄露任意内核内存的Spectre攻击。研究还发现编译器、操作系统和应用层缓解措施大范围缺失，且RISC-V指令集缺少专用推测屏障；作者经验性刻画了可停止推测的指令，审计Linux内核中的Spectre gadget并提交补丁，部分已被上游接受。最后，他们评估并基准测试了基于软件的Spectre缓解方案，为RISC-V生态安全部署提供建议。

paper.title: Exploiting Hidden Resource Contention in Selective Speculation Defenses
paper.description: Xiaoyu Cheng, Southeast University; Fei Tong, Southeast University; Purple Mountain Laboratories; Jiangsu Province Engineering Research Center of Security for Ubiquitous Network; Zhenyu Lei, Fang Jiang, Zhe Zhou, and Guang Cheng, Southeast University; Trevor E. Carlson, National University of Singapore (NUS) Transient execution attacks continue to evolve beyond cache-centric channels, motivating selective speculation defenses that aim to provide comprehensive protection with low overhead by delaying only transmit instructions. In this work, we show that several state-of-the-art selective-speculation defenses rest on shared assumptions that overlook important microarchitectural behaviors, leaving systematic blind spots that admit secret-dependent reservation-station (RS) contention. Our analysis identifies three limitations in optimized selective-speculation designs. First, existing transmit taxonomies emphasize post-issue execution effects and miss dispatch-phase channels, such as operand-dependent μop expansion in instructions (e.g., REP-prefixed string operations) that create operand-dependent RS occupancy before execution. Second, the delay-until-resolution strategy focuses on redirect-based control leakage, but predicated instructions (e.g., x86 CMOV and RISC-V Zicond) enable secret-dependent selection without branch resolution, allowing secrets to steer operand-dependent μop expansion (e.g., REP iteration counts). Finally, the older-μop-first allocation strategy assumes unsafe contention is prevented by prioritizing non-transient μops, yet undelayed arithmetic and cache-hit memory μops can still lead to secret-dependent RS pressure through latency-amplifying dependency chains. Guided by these findings, we construct Spectre-v1-style gadgets that bypass STT/DOLMA on x86 and RISC-V gem5 models. We further validate RS-contention effects on real CPUs, including a REP MOVSB- and REP STOSB-based proof-of-concept and a real-world RS-contention pattern identified by our LLVM pass, demonstrating realistic gadget structure and measurable signal. Finally, we propose strengthened STT mechanisms that close both existing and newly exposed gaps at moderate performance overhead.
paper.author: Xiaoyu Cheng, Southeast University; Fei Tong, Southeast University; Purple Mountain Laboratories; Jiangsu Province Engineering Research Center of Security for Ubiquitous Network; Zhenyu Lei, Fang Jiang, Zhe Zhou, and Guang Cheng, Southeast University; Trevor E. Carlson, National University of Singapore (NUS)
paper.summary_zh: 瞬态执行攻击已从以缓存为中心的通道持续演化，催生了只延迟发送指令的选择性推测防御，以在低开销下提供全面保护。本文揭示若干先进选择性推测防御存在共享假设盲点，会暴露秘密相关的保留站（RS）竞争：包括分发阶段的操作数相关μop展开、利用谓词指令进行秘密相关选择，以及旧μop优先分配策略下未延迟算术与缓存命中内存μop仍可造成RS压力。作者据此构造了可绕过x86与RISC-V gem5模型上STT/DOLMA的Spectre-v1风格gadget，并在真实CPU上验证了基于REP MOVSB和REP STOSB的概念验证及LLVM pass发现的真实竞争模式。最后提出增强型STT机制，以中等性能开销封堵已有和新暴露的缺口。

paper.title: STALEUS: Breaking AMD SEV-SNP via Memory Incoherence
paper.description: AMD SEV-SNP provides confidential computing capabilities on AMD platforms. To secure confidential virtual machines, AMD relies on a trusted co-processor known as the Platform Security Processor (PSP). The PSP executes on an Arm core, which is connected to the x86 interconnect via dedicated hardware bridges. We show that a malicious hypervisor can configure one of these bridges to render the PSP cache-incoherent with respect to the x86 caches. We present a novel attack called STALEUS that demonstrates how to leverage this vulnerability to break SEV-SNP. We show the impact of STALEUS by achieving arbitrary read and write primitives within a fully attested CVM
paper.author: Benedict Schlüter and Shweta Shinde, ETH Zurich
paper.summary_zh: AMD SEV-SNP在AMD平台提供机密计算能力，为保护机密虚拟机，AMD依赖名为平台安全处理器（PSP）的可信协处理器；该PSP运行在Arm核上，并通过专用硬件桥连接到x86互连。本文展示恶意hypervisor可配置其中一个桥，使PSP相对于x86缓存变为缓存不一致。作者提出新型攻击STALEUS，利用该漏洞破坏SEV-SNP，并在完全认证的CVM中实现任意读写原语。

paper.title: “Maybe there’s only one passkey?”: Challenges Investigating and Remediating Adversarial Passkeys
paper.description: Passkeys are being actively rolled out by hundreds of web services who market them as a promising passwordless authentication method. However, it remains unclear whether people understand how to manage passkeys as part of their broader account security management, particularly in the aftermath of account compromise. We conducted a qualitative lab-based study that explores how people investigate and remediate suspicious activity when passkeys are used as a vector for illicit account access on three popular, passkey-supporting services: Google, PayPal, and LinkedIn. We recruited 31 participants with diverse technical backgrounds and tasked them with: (1) investigating a potential incident of compromise involving passkeys and (2) taking steps needed to re-secure the account. Participants struggled to manage passkeys within account security settings and on devices, even when supported by service-provided email notifications, account security interfaces (ASIs), and streamlined wizards. The design and content of notifications and ASIs were often confusing or unclear, while the service-provided wizards were incomplete or misleading. This resulted in participants missing key steps required to discover adversarial passkeys and fully secure the account to prevent continued adversarial access. We discuss design implications and opportunities for future work to improve passkey management tools in ways that better support people experiencing account compromise.
paper.author: Alaa Daffalla, Cornell University; Grace Myers, Cornell Tech; Rosanna Bellini, New York University; Thomas Ristenpart, University of Toronto; Nicola Dell, Cornell Tech
paper.summary_zh: Passkeys正被大量Web服务推广为无密码认证方案，但用户是否理解如何在账户被盗后管理passkey仍不清楚。本文通过基于实验室的定性研究，招募31名不同技术背景的参与者，在Google、PayPal和LinkedIn上调查涉及passkey的可疑账户访问并采取重新保护账户的措施。参与者即使有服务邮件通知、账户安全界面和精简向导，仍难以在账户设置和设备上管理passkey；通知与界面常令人困惑，向导不完整或误导，导致他们遗漏发现恶意passkey和完全保护账户的关键步骤。作者讨论了设计启示，以改进passkey管理工具并更好地支持遭遇账户入侵的用户。

paper.title: Designing Wallet-Based User Intervention for Approval Phishing Mitigation
paper.description: Approval phishing is a form of Web3 phishing that exploits token approval mechanisms to trick users into granting attackers spending authority over their tokens. As attackers increasingly hijack legitimate websites, URL-based detection alone becomes insufficient, leaving crypto wallets as the last line of defense. Based on the characteristics of approval mechanisms, we propose four wallet-based interventions for mitigating approval phishing: Spending Cap Suggestion, Active Spender Warning, Passive Spender Warning, and Delayed Confirmation. We evaluate the interventions through a between-subjects experiment (n = 364) and semi-structured interviews (n = 23). Compared with the control group, the Spending Cap Suggestion condition significantly increases the likelihood that users set spending caps. The Active Spender Warning, Passive Spender Warning, and Delayed Confirmation conditions all increase cancellation rates of phishing tasks, although the increases are statistically significant only for Active Spender Warning and Delayed Confirmation conditions. The effectiveness of the interventions varies across users, as users may struggle to interpret suspicious cues and focus on transaction outcomes while overlooking approval details. Our findings highlight the need to strengthen defenses against such attacks by increasing users' awareness of post-approval consequences and supporting approval-parameter verification at the moment of authorization.
paper.author: Maggie Yongqi Guan, University of Macau; Yuqi Xu, Yunlong Mao, and Wei Tong, Nanjing University; Xiaobo Zhou and Kanye Ye Wang, University of Macau
paper.summary_zh: 审批式钓鱼是Web3中利用代币授权机制诱骗用户授予攻击者消费权限的钓鱼形式；由于攻击者越来越多地劫持合法网站，仅靠URL检测不足，加密钱包成为最后防线。本文基于审批机制特征提出四种钱包干预：消费上限建议、主动消费方警告、被动消费方警告和延迟确认。作者通过受试者间实验（n=364）和半结构化访谈（n=23）评估发现，消费上限建议显著提高用户设置消费上限的可能性；主动消费方警告和延迟确认显著提高取消钓鱼任务的比例；被动警告也有提高但不显著。干预效果因用户而异，用户可能难以解读可疑线索并关注交易结果而忽略授权细节，因此需要增强用户对授权后后果的认识，并在授权时支持审批参数验证。

paper.title: What Adults Will (and Won't) Do to Prove Their Age: Empirical Evidence from a Deceptive Web Experiment
paper.description: As age verification laws proliferate across the United States and internationally, limited empirical evidence exists on how adults actually respond to these systems in practice. We conducted an IRB-approved, deceptive web experiment (n = 1,635) to examine how different age verification methods affect adults' decisions to access age-restricted content. Participants, recruited to evaluate R-rated movie clips, were randomly assigned to one of seven verification conditions: checkbox self-attestation, government-issued ID upload (with varying privacy reassurances), government-issued ID with liveness check, AI facial age estimation, or email age estimation. Completion rates varied substantially by method. Checkbox self-attestation achieved 99% completion, government-ID methods 18–27% regardless of reassurances, email 86%, and AI 51%. Follow-up surveys (n = 881) revealed low comfort even among participants who completed verification. Participants perceived government-ID and AI methods as significantly riskier, rated no method as particularly effective at preventing minors' access, and found government-ID methods significantly less convenient. Higher comfort and lower perceived risk were associated with higher completion. These findings have important implications for balancing child protection with adults' access rights. We offer recommendations for policymakers and platform operators implementing age verification systems.
paper.author: Yanzi Lin and Cheng Zhang, Carnegie Mellon University; Madelyne Xiao, Princeton University; Lorrie Faith Cranor and Sarah Scheffler, Carnegie Mellon University
paper.summary_zh: 随着美国及国际年龄验证法律增多，成年人在实践中如何响应这些系统仍缺乏实证证据。本文开展经IRB批准的欺骗性网络实验（n=1,635），让参与者评估R级电影片段，并随机分配到七种验证条件：复选框自证、政府身份证上传（不同隐私保证）、政府身份证加活体检测、AI面部年龄估计或电子邮件年龄估计。结果显示完成率差异显著：复选框自证99%，政府身份证方法18–27%，电子邮件86%，AI 51%；后续调查（n=881）发现即使完成验证者舒适度也低。参与者认为政府身份证和AI方法风险更高，认为没有方法能特别有效阻止未成年人访问，且政府身份证方法显著更不便；更高舒适度和更低感知风险与更高完成率相关。作者为政策制定者和平台提供建议，以平衡儿童保护与成年人访问权。

paper.title: X-rated Compliance Theater: An Empirical Evaluation of European Age Verification Systems in Adult Websites
paper.description: Age verification is rapidly emerging as a central regulatory instrument for protecting minors online, with several jurisdictions mandating its deployment for access to adult and pornographic content. This regulatory direction raises significant privacy concerns, as it risks binding sensitive content access to identity-related attributes. It also introduces security risks, since age-verification mechanisms are often outsourced to third-party providers with limited transparency into the robustness of their verification processes. In this work, we conduct, to the best of our knowledge, the first exploratory security assessment of regulation-mandated age-verification mechanisms deployed by adult websites. Rather than treating age verification as a purely regulatory question, we empirically examine whether current deployments provide security guarantees commensurate with the privacy risks of relying on sensitive identity-related data. Our methodology combines ecosystem mapping, adversary modeling, and empirical testing across four countries, covering document-based verification, biometric age estimation, indirect signals, and website-workflow integration. Our results reveal systemic weaknesses across mechanisms and integrations under realistic threat assumptions, including failures against low-cost, widely accessible attacks. Finally, we derive concrete guidelines and design directions for mitigating the security and privacy risks exposed by current age-verification deployments.
paper.author: Simone Lavermicocca, Michele Carminati, and Stefano Longari, Politecnico di Milano
paper.summary_zh: 随着多国强制要求成人内容访问部署年龄验证，相关系统可能将敏感内容访问与身份属性绑定，并因外包给透明度有限的第三方而引入安全风险。本文首次对成人网站部署的、由法规强制要求的年龄验证机制进行探索性安全评估，方法结合生态系统映射、敌手建模和在四个国家的实证测试，覆盖文档验证、生物特征年龄估计、间接信号与网站工作流集成。结果显示，在现实威胁假设下这些机制和集成存在系统性弱点，甚至可被低成本、易获取的攻击攻破。作者最后提出具体指南和设计方向，以缓解当前年龄验证部署暴露的安全与隐私风险。

paper.title: XCFI: Comprehensive Control-Flow Integrity for Arm TrustZone-M
paper.description: Arm TrustZone-M (TZ-M) provides hardware-based isolation for tiny embedded systems by partitioning execution into secure and non-secure states. However, despite this isolation, memory vulnerabilities in software running within either state can still be exploited to perform control-flow hijacking attacks. To mitigate these threats, numerous control-flow integrity (CFI) studies have been proposed for embedded systems, but they have several limitations: many neglect the secure state, fail to protect control-flow events during TZ-M security state transitions, or incur prohibitive performance overhead. In this paper, we present XCFI, a comprehensive CFI mechanism for TZ-M. XCFI employs a 32-bit control-flow identifier (CID) based protection to uniformly enforce fine-grained CFI across both secure and non-secure states, covering all control-flow events, including indirect branches, returns, and exceptions. Crucially, XCFI extends CFI enforcement to cross-state control-flow events in TZ-M, which have not been protected by prior work.
